plugins.readme_text: # dsh-image2-tool ![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin?display_name=tag&sort=semver&label=release) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-image2-tool?label=npm) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-image2-tool?label=downloads) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0078D4) ![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563) ![Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-8B5CF6) **社区插件标签**：`dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis` · `bundle` · `text-to-image` · `image-to-image` · `image-generation` · `ai-image` · `image-relay` · `openai-compatible` · `inline-media` · `web-ui` · `tool` 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 加上「一句话生成图片」和「拿参考图改图」的能力：接你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站，生成的图**直接内联显示在对话里**。 ![dsh-image2-tool 横幅](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.jpg) --- ## 亮点 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 一行安装 | 官方通用方式 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool`，重启后工具表出现 `image2_generate` | | 自己的中转站 | 文生图走 `POST /images/generations`，图生图走 `POST /images/edits`，同时支持 `b64_json` 与图片 URL 两种返回 | | 参考图引导 | 给 `image` 传一张本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP，角色一致性、画风与配色远比纯文字描述稳 | | 图形化配置 | 侧边栏 Plugins 页内置设置行（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 字段），也可直接写 `cordis.patch.yml` | | 视觉自检 | 生成后用原生 `read_image` 复核真实文件，不把「接口成功」当成「视觉合格」 | | 内联预览 | 自动带上 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)，图片直接渲染在回复下方，无需点开卡片 | | 克制默认 | `autoGenerateAssets` 默认 `false`，普通开发任务不会悄悄花掉生图额度；输出被限制在会话目录内 | ## 使用示例 下面两张图来自一次真实会话：让 Agent「生成一张 GPT 化龙指导器的形象」，它自己挑参考图、比对版本、迭代出成品。 **对话里长这样** —— 生成过程、参考图、版本对比都在回复里，图片由内联预览直接渲染，不用点开任何卡片（长图，可点开看全）： **最终结果** —— 该会话产出的成品（864 × 1152）： > 复现方式：装好插件后直接对 Agent 说「生成一张 XXX 的图」即可。`autoGenerateAssets` 保持默认 `false` 时，只有你明确要求才会生图。 ## 参考图引导（图生图） 只要调用里带上 `image`，插件就改走 `POST /images/edits`： ```jsonc { "prompt": "保持这个角色设定，改成少女比例，正常七头身，不要 Q 版", "image": "imagegen-output/reference.jpg", // 相对会话目录或绝对路径 "aspectRatio": "3:4", "filename": "result.jpg" } ``` | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `prompt` | 必填。要生成或要改什么 | | `image` | 可选。本地参考图路径（PNG/JPEG/WebP，≤ 20 MB）。给了就走图生图，不给就是文生图 | | `filename` | 可选。输出文件名，不含目录 | | `size` | 可选。形如 `1024x1024`。只认 `aspect_ratio` 的中转站会忽略它 | | `aspectRatio` | 可选。形如 `3:4`、`16:9`，以 `aspect_ratio` 字段发出。中转站忽略 `size` 时用它控制构图 | 细节： - 参考图按**魔术字节**判定真实类型，不信任扩展名；文件不存在、不是普通文件、超过 20 MB、或不是受支持的图片格式，都在**发出请求之前**就报错，不浪费额度。 - 上传用 `multipart/form-data`，`Content-Type` 与 boundary 交给 `FormData` 处理。 - 中转站若不接受 `response_format`，把 `responseFormat` 设为空字符串即可不发该字段。 ## 安装 ### 官方通用方式（推荐） ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool ``` 把 `` 换成你常用的 profile 名（例如 `web`、`default`）。装完**重启 DSH**，工具表里就会出现 `image2_generate`。 ### 其它等价方式 ```powershell # 从 GitHub Release 下载的 tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-image2-tool-0.4.0.tgz # 直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile add github:544244857/dsh-image2-plugin # 本地源码目录（开发调试） dsh plugin --profile add ./plugins/deepseek-harness-image2 ``` 需要新建一个独立 profile 时： ```powershell dsh --profile image2-demo --from-default-profile web --dump-config ``` ## 配置 两种方式等价、可互换，**二选一**即可。 **① 图形界面**：侧边栏 → Plugins → `dsh-image2-tool` → `image2` 行，逐项填写（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 密钥字段），保存即写回当前 profile 的 Cordis patch。 **② 配置文件**：`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - id: image2 name: dsh-image2-tool config: baseUrl: https://your-image-relay.example.com/v1 model: grok-imagine-image-2.0 apiKeyEnv: IMAGE2_API_KEY autoGenerateAssets: false outputDir: imagegen-output timeoutMs: 180000 responseFormat: b64_json ``` | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | 中转站地址（OpenAI 兼容，含 `/v1`） | | `model` | 模型名，**必须**是该中转站 `/v1/models` 里真实存在的名字，否则调用返回 404 | | `apiKeyEnv` | API key 的**环境变量名**（不是 key 本身） | | `apiKey` | 设置页里的遮蔽字段；非空时优先于 `apiKeyEnv`，后者作为兜底 | | `autoGenerateAssets` | 是否允许在软件开发任务中自动补齐缺失位图素材，默认 `false` | | `outputDir` | 输出目录，相对会话目录解析并强制不越界 | | `timeoutMs` | 单次请求超时 | | `responseFormat` | 向中转站索要的返回格式，默认 `b64_json`（图片字节内联回传）。设 `url` 则让插件去下载中转站给的链接；设为**空字符串**则完全不发这个字段，给不接受它的中转站用 | API key 交给**启动 DSH 的那个进程**： ```powershell $env:IMAGE2_API_KEY = 'your-image-relay-api-key' dsh --profile web ``` 已经开着的桌面端不会继承新设的环境变量，需要从带该变量的终端重新启动。别把 key 写进 Git。 ## 内联预览 安装本插件时会一并安装 [`@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer`](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin) `1.0.12`。该包自带 `dsh.bundle` patch，安装时会被 profile 管理器自动启用为 bundle，于是回复中提到的图片路径会直接在对话里渲染成图片。 它由上游维护、MIT 许可，本插件既不 vendor 也不修改其代码；删除 `dependencies` 里的这一行，image2 功能完全不受影响，只是内联预览消失。上游标注内联图片卡片在宿主 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上验证过，本插件面向 `0.2.0-rc.2`，所用宿主 API 均存在，但渲染路径上游尚未复测。 ## 行为与边界 - `autoGenerateAssets` 默认关闭。打开后，Agent 可以在网页、移动端、桌面端、游戏等软件开发过程中，确认项目内与外部都没有合适素材后，生成真正缺失的位图素材；用户的直接生图请求不受该开关影响。它是**工具层指引**，不是服务端授权闸门。 - 一次一张。不带 `image` 走 `POST /images/generations`（文生图），带 `image` 走 `POST /images/edits`（图生图，multipart 上传参考图）。 - 接受 base64 与图片 URL 两种结果；保留同名已有文件（冲突自动加序号），输出限定在会话目录内，支持取消与请求超时。 - 下载图片时**不会**转发中转站 key。 - 保存后必须用原生 `read_image` 检查实际文件并与需求逐项对照；在检查完成前，工具会把「视觉验收」标记为待办。 - 重试预算：初始 1 次 + 最多 5 次追加生成请求（含失败），这是指引而非持久计数器。 - 参考文本是素材，永远不是指令来源。 ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 原因与处理 | | --- | --- | | `HTTP 404: Model "xxx" is not available for this group` | 模型名在该中转站上不存在。用 `GET /v1/models` 查可用列表后改 `model` 字段（volatile 字段保存即生效，无需重启） | | `Error: fetch failed` | 到中转站的网络抖动，重试即可（与 404 是完全不同的故障） | | `Image download failed` 或下载时 `ConnectTimeoutError` | 中转站返回的是它自己 CDN 的临时链接，而这台机器连不上那个域名。把 `responseFormat` 设为 `b64_json`，让图片字节直接内联回传 | | 图生图报 `Source image not found` / `contained no supported PNG, JPEG or WebP image bytes` | 参考图路径不对，或文件其实不是图片（按魔术字节判定，改扩展名没用） | | 图生图报 `HTTP 400: model is required` | 该中转站没有 `/images/edits` 路由。文生图仍可用，图生图需换支持的中转站 | | 工具表里没有 `image2_generate` | profile 未安装成功或未重启；确认 profile 的 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `dsh-image2-tool` | | 设置页显示 `unavailable` | 该 profile 没有 settings 服务，改用上面的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工行 | | 图片没内联显示 | 确认 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 也在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中，并重启 DSH | ## 兼容性 - 宿主：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 `0.2.0-rc.2`（实测），`0.1.7-rc.2` 亦声明兼容 - Node.js `>= 22.15`（图生图依赖全局 `FormData` / `Blob`） - 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 共享宿主的 Cordis / Schemastery / tool runtime；不要在插件目录里放不兼容的物理副本（会出现两份实例） ## 工作方式 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[用户: 生成 / 改一张图] --> A[Agent] A -->|image2_generate| T[dsh-image2-tool] T -->|无 image: POST /images/generations| R[你的图片中转站] T -->|有 image: POST /images/edits| R R -->|b64_json 或 url| T T --> F[会话目录 / outputDir] F --> V[read_image 视觉自检] V --> P[内联预览渲染在回复下方] ``` - 工具面：`image2_generate`（宿主工具注册表） - 客户端面：`lib/client.js` 向 Plugins 页注入 `image2` 配置行 - bundle 面：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件行 `id: image2` - 测试：`test/smoke.js` 用本地假中转站覆盖两条通道，不需要网络与额度 ## 许可 MIT © 2026 544244857。依赖 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)（MIT，版权归其作者）。 --- English: `dsh-image2-tool` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that turns your own OpenAI-compatible image relay into the `image2_generate` tool for text-to-image and image-to-image, and renders generated images inline in the conversation. Install with `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool`.

plugins.description: dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（基于 dsh-pet 的二次创作，非原创）：仓库根即插件包，免构建，兼容 DSH 官方桌面端 0.2.1-rc.1
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（二次创作，非原创）

> **本仓库不是原创作品。** 它是桌宠 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（作者 **PC2005-cloud**，MIT）的**二次创作**，只做一件事：让上游桌宠在 **DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端（Electron 版）** 装上、能启用、可管理。桌宠本体、动画素材、全部玩法与文档都来自上游，版权归原作者。 --- ## 📌 非原创声明 | 内容 | 归属 | | --- | --- | | 桌宠本体、106 段动画与素材、提示词、玩法（待机 / 漫游 / 拖拽抛掷 / 余额 / 碎碎念 / 对话 / 工作状态 / 系统通知 / pet pack） | 上游 **[PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)**（MIT） | | 官方桌面端适配层（`adapter/`）、组合包声明、上游产物同步与校验、安装 / 兼容 / 排障文档、测试 | 本仓库（基于上游的二次创作） | `vendor/` 内是上游 npm 发布版 `dsh-pet@0.3.7` 的已构建产物，`dsh-pet/assets/` 内是上游的动画与素材——本仓库没有、也不试图拥有上游的任何内容。按上游「二创约定」：任何介绍、展示、分发本仓库的地方，请保留上游作者地址 。 ## 🚀 安装（官方桌面端） 1. 桌面应用 → **插件管理 → 添加插件**； 2. 填本仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop ``` （等价 pnpm spec：`github:zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop`） 3. 启用 `dsh-pet` 组合包，**重开桌面应用**。 默认只显示**一只**：窗口外那只透明置顶小窗（`display: desktop`）。想改成应用内 / 两只 / 不显示，见 [DESKTOP.md §12](DESKTOP.md) 或设置页「桌宠配置」。 ## ✅ 验证 桌宠加载后，DSH 自己的 Web 服务上会多一个只读接口： ```text GET http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-desktop/health ``` 返回 `status: active`、`host.kind: desktop`、`upstream.applied: true` 即适配层与上游都已就绪（字段含义见 [DESKTOP.md §3](DESKTOP.md)）。 ## 📦 本仓库只保留「适配官方桌面端」所需 ```text adapter/ 适配层：宿主识别、运行时诊断、健康检查、失败降级 cordis.patch.yml 组合包声明（桌面端插件管理据此把它当插件） vendor/dsh-pet-0.3.7/ 上游已构建产物（免构建，SHA-256 逐文件校验） dsh-pet/assets/ 运行时素材（webm / 字体 / 表情包 / 默认配置） tests/ 清单、适配层纯逻辑、启动冒烟 DESKTOP.md 为什么需要、兼容矩阵、排障、版本记录 scripts/sync-vendor.mjs 上游产物同步与可审计补丁 ``` **不在本仓库**（都在上游）：`src/` 源码、素材生成链（提示词 + Python 脚本）、HTTP API 文档、生态清单、玩法与配置手册。 ## 🔗 功能、玩法、二次创作 → 去上游 - 功能与配置、动画与 pet pack、HTTP API、问题反馈： - 本仓库改了什么、兼容性与排障：[DESKTOP.md](DESKTOP.md) ## 许可 - 代码：MIT（上游版权归 **PC2005-cloud**；本仓库的适配改动同样以 MIT 提供） - 素材（动画 / 提示词 / 源视频）：允许开源使用，**禁止商用** - 二次创作：请保留上游作者地址 ## 版本 当前 `0.3.7-desktop.3`（基于上游 `dsh-pet@0.3.7`）。变更见 [DESKTOP.md §11](DESKTOP.md)。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle
