# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Wake the agent when a directory changes, with the diff and without the echo of its own writes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folderwatch

**Wake the agent when the filesystem changes — not when you remember to look.**

An agent can already be woken on a clock (scheduled tasks) and on an HTTP request (webhooks). Neither covers the case that actually matters mid-session: something *outside* the conversation touches a file. A build finishes. A formatter rewrites the tree. A test runner drops a report. A download lands. A colleague pushes into a shared folder. Today the agent finds out only if it happens to look.

`dsh-folderwatch` arms a directory against the agent that armed it. When the tree changes, the agent receives an exact account of what changed — and can either be woken to act on it or simply find it waiting at its next step.

```
[folderwatch] 3 changes under /work/shop/reports
watch: reports · 14:02:11
1 created · 1 modified · 1 deleted
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
(4 events suppressed as this session's own writes)

Read the new report and summarise what failed.
```

## Why it is not just `fs.watch` and a callback

Three decisions separate a watcher you keep armed from one you uninstall after an afternoon:

### 1. Snapshots, not raw events

`fs.watch` reports that *something* happened, not *what*. It double-fires on Windows, sometimes reports no filename at all, and silently drops events under load. A watcher built directly on it tells the agent "something changed" — which is not enough to act on.

This plugin takes **snapshots and diffs them**. Renames, deletions and bursts are classified correctly on every platform, and each change arrives with its size. `fs.watch` is kept only as a *hint to rescan sooner*; the periodic rescan is the correctness path.

### 2. Echo suppression

A watcher on a directory the agent is editing has an obvious failure mode. The agent writes `src/app.ts`, the watcher fires, the agent is told `src/app.ts` changed, it reads the file it just wrote. That one settles — but a build, a formatter or a test runner the agent *itself* started keeps writing, and each write wakes the agent again. The result is a loop that burns tokens and reads as if the workspace were under attack by a stranger.

So tool calls that name a file are recorded in a short-lived ledger, and changes to those paths inside the window are counted as **suppressed** rather than delivered. The window is deliberately short (`echoWindowMs`, default 2500ms): a file the agent wrote ten minutes ago changing *now* is real news.

The suppression is visible rather than silent — every batch reports how many events it filtered, so you can tell "nothing happened" from "the agent did it itself".

### 3. Delivery is opt-in per watch

| mode | call | effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wake` *(default)* | `agent.followup(message)` | starts a new turn |
| `queue` | `agent.inject(message)` | waits for the agent's next step |

A watcher that can always interrupt is a watcher nobody leaves armed. The quieter option is one argument away, so you can arm a watch for a whole session without handing it the power to interrupt you.

## Install

```
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-folderwatch
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-folderwatch
```

The package declares no `dsh-*` peer dependency on purpose: it imports only `node:*` plus `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, all of which the harness resolves from its own installation. Nothing is bundled that could shadow the host's copy.

To tune it per profile, add a `config` block to the row the installer inserted in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: folderwatch
      name: 'dsh-folderwatch'
      config:
        quietMs: 400
        cooldownMs: 5000
        watches:
          - path: E:/work/reports
            label: reports
            pattern: '**/*.json'
            prompt: Read the new report and summarise what failed.
            mode: wake
```

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `watches` | `[]` | Watches armed at load time. Arming from a session with the tool is the usual path. |
| `ignore` | build/VCS/dependency dirs | Ignore patterns applied to every watch, merged with each watch's own list. |
| `quietMs` | `400` | Quiet period before a batch is delivered. |
| `maxWaitMs` | `5000` | Ceiling on how long changes may wait for quiet, so a never-quiet tree still reports. |
| `cooldownMs` | `5000` | Minimum gap between deliveries for one watch. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `1500` | How often the tree is rescanned. |
| `maxWatches` | `16` | Maximum number of simultaneously armed watches. |
| `maxEntries` | `20000` | Snapshot entry cap, guarding against a runaway tree. |
| `echoWindowMs` | `2500` | How long a path stays suppressed after this session writes it. |
| `maxEventsPerMessage` | `60` | Events listed in one notification before truncation. |

## Tools

### `folderwatch_add`

Arm a watch. Returns the arm report, or the reason it could not be armed.

| argument | type | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string *(required)* | Directory to watch. Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `label` | string | Short name shown in listings and notifications. |
| `prompt` | string | Instruction appended to each notification, e.g. `re-run the failing test`. |
| `pattern` | string | Glob selecting which paths are reported, e.g. `**/*.log`. |
| `ignore` | string[] | Extra ignore patterns for this watch. A bare name like `tmp` matches at any depth. |
| `recursive` | boolean | Descend into subdirectories. Defaults to `true`. |
| `once` | boolean | Disarm after the first delivery. Defaults to `false`. |
| `mode` | `"wake"` \| `"queue"` | Delivery mode. Defaults to `wake`. |
| `sessionId` | string | Session to notify, when it is not the calling one. |

```
dsh-folderwatch · armed "reports"
  root:      /work/shop/reports
  watching:  12 file(s), 3 directories (recursive)
  pattern:   **/*.json
  ignoring:  node_modules, .git
  deliver:   wake the agent (followup)

Changes are reported in batches after the tree goes quiet, and this session's own writes are filtered out.
```

### `folderwatch_list`

The inventory: what each watch is watching, how often it has fired, and whether anything is pending.

```
dsh-folderwatch · 2 watches
  reports  running  12 file(s)  2 delivery(ies)  last fired 1m ago
    /work/shop/reports  [**/*.json]
  inbox  stopped  12 file(s)  0 delivery(ies)  never fired
    /work/shop/inbox
    3 change(s) pending delivery
```

### `folderwatch_check`

Rescan now and report what changed **without delivering a message**. This is how you answer "has anything happened yet" during a turn instead of waiting to be woken.

```
dsh-folderwatch · check "reports" · 3 change(s) since the last scan
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
  (4 further event(s) were this session's own writes)

This was a check: the snapshot advanced and no message was delivered.
```

### `folderwatch_fire`

Deliver a watch's pending changes immediately instead of waiting for the quiet period. Useful to confirm the delivery path works, or when a batch is known to be complete. When nothing is pending, it says so and sends nothing.

### `folderwatch_remove`

Disarm a watch and release its filesystem handles. Reports what it delivered while armed.

```
dsh-folderwatch · disarmed "reports"
  root: /work/shop/reports
  delivered 2 batch(es) over 7 event(s) while armed
  filtered 4 event(s) that were this session's own writes
```

## Slash command

```
/watch                                              # inventory
/watch add ./reports --pattern '**/*.json'          # arm, waking the agent
/watch add ./build --queue                          # arm, waiting for the next step
/watch add ./inbox --once                           # disarm after the first delivery
/watch check reports                                # rescan without delivering
/watch fire reports                                 # deliver now
/watch rm repor

# dsh-starry-sky-theme

A dark-only starry-sky theme for **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH) Web UI: a deep-space palette, a slowly twinkling starfield, and faint constellation figures behind the interface.

![Starry Sky icon](./icon.svg)

## Features

- **One sky for both appearance settings.** Light and Dark both resolve to the night sky. The Client half pins the appearance preference to `dark`, so picking *Light* in Settings → Appearance is corrected back to *Dark* while the plugin is enabled.
- **Deep-space palette.** Navy-violet surfaces, moonlit text, and a starlight-blue accent applied as an alias-token layer.
- **Constellation figures.** Four faint star-chart polylines with glowing anchor stars, drawn in the same sky as the twinkling stars.
- **Quiet by design.** The sky sits in the frame-wide click-through overlay: no pointer capture, no layout shift, and it honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Removable.** Disabling the plugin removes the palette layer and the sky in the same HMR pass, and stops pinning the appearance.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (Web UI).
- No extra dependencies: the Client half uses only the `react` module the Harness already provides.

## Install

From the **Plugin Market** (once listed): Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market → Themes, choose *Starry Sky*.

Or install the package into a profile directly:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-starry-sky-theme
```

Then reload the page. The plugin activates immediately; no restart is needed for the Client half.

## Use

- Open Settings → Appearance: the plugin keeps the appearance on **Dark**. The Light choice is available in the stock UI but snaps back while the plugin is enabled.
- To choose Light again, disable the plugin in Settings → Plugins (or remove it). The saved preference stays `dark` until you change it.
- To turn the sky off, disable the plugin; the original palette returns immediately.

## How it works

The Client module registers three things:

1. `theme.overrideTokens('<package id>', tokens)` — an alias-token layer with the dark value repeated for both color schemes, composed over the active theme and removed when the plugin is disposed.
2. A `theme/change` listener that calls `theme.setTheme('dark')` whenever the resolved scheme is light, so both appearance settings stay night.
3. `slots.register('shell.overlay', ...)` — a `pointer-events: none` sky layer rendered above every column. Stars are generated deterministically (seeded PRNG), constellation lines are fixed percentage coordinates, and the twinkle is CSS keyframes (disabled under reduced motion).

No DOM outside the component is touched, no other plugin's styles are read, and no session state is modified.

## License

MIT © 2026 Nektropy

## 中文简介

DeepSeek Harness 的深色星空主题：深空底色、缓慢闪烁的星点，以及四组淡淡的星座连线。浅色与深色外观都被统一为深色——插件启用时会把外观固定在深色，选择「浅色」会被自动改回。关闭插件即移除配色层与星空，并停止固定外观。支持 DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` 的 Web 界面。

# dsh-context

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**上下文长度管理**插件：实施方案 + 可直接安装的最小骨架。
插件包名 **`ctx-mon-and-con`**（目录 `plugin-skeleton/`）。

> A context-length management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a design document plus a minimal, installable plugin skeleton.

## 这是什么

DSH 已经内置了完整的上下文管理底座——计量（`ctx.tokenMeter`）、压缩 seam（`ctx.compaction`）、
工具结果裁剪（`ctx.toolResultPruner`）、会话投影（`ctx.sessionProjections`）。
本仓库不重新造压缩，而是把「**插件应该在哪一层介入、怎么介入、有哪些红线**」讲清楚，
并给出一个能装在 Desktop 里的最小实现：宿主半侧的 `/ctx` 监控面板，加上挂在 agent preset 内、
按上下文自动压缩的 `ctx-mon-and-con/control` 控制半侧。

## 仓库结构

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/context-length-plugin-plan.md`](docs/context-length-plugin-plan.md) | 完整实施方案：请求组装链路、四条介入路线（L0 配置 / L1 观察 / L2 裁剪 / L3 换后端）、可抄的 patch 片段、安装验证、红线清单 |
| [`plugin-skeleton/`](plugin-skeleton) | 可安装插件：宿主半侧 `/ctx`（监控 + 会话级上下文覆盖）与 `settings.section` 面板；控制半侧 `control.js` 挂进 agent preset 后按上下文自动压缩。含 32 项静态检查、43 项 Cordis 冒烟、33 项控制测试 |
| [`research/arch.md`](research/arch.md) | DSH 插件机制调研：三层结构、Host 插件形态、`dsh` 清单字段、patch DSL、客户端 slots、安装与 HMR |
| [`research/context-core.md`](research/context-core.md) | 上下文/压缩子系统调研：请求组装、token 计量、压缩服务与事件协议、默认后端配置、五条内容变换通道、真实装配层 |
| [`research/sample-plugin.md`](research/sample-plugin.md) | 参考实现分析：`billion-context` / `dsh-bloom-theme` / `dshmarket`，以及第三方插件的模块解析结论 |
| [`docs/market-submission.md`](docs/market-submission.md) | 为什么在插件市场里搜不到、收录规则逐条核对、已实测的安装命令，以及还差的三步 |
| [`submission/`](submission) | 可直接复制进收录 PR 的条目文件 `qiangweiliu__dsh-context--plugin-skeleton.yml` |
| [`scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1`](scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1) | 实测「安装 → 生效 → 卸载 → 无残留」：快照对比、残留分类、`-Clean` 清理通用残留 |
| [`scripts/ui-probe.mjs`](scripts/ui-probe.mjs) | 无头浏览器（Windows Edge + CDP）实测 UI：打开设置、点开「上下文长度」、执行 `/ctx`，抓控制台错误 |
| [`scripts/ui-probe-ctx.mjs`](scripts/ui-probe-ctx.mjs) · [`ui-check-dock.mjs`](scripts/ui-check-dock.mjs) · [`ui-check-inventory.mjs`](scripts/ui-check-inventory.mjs) | 实测侧边栏 `ctx` 整页、面板改上下文/一键启用压缩、输入框 ctx 指示器，以及工具/提示词开关（会话生效 + 全局持久化） |
| [`scripts/wsl-install.sh`](scripts/wsl-install.sh) · [`scripts/wsl-uninstall.sh`](scripts/wsl-uninstall.sh) | 在 WSL 的 DSH profile 里安装/卸载并核对残留（含运行时探针说明） |

## 快速开始

先把 `plugin-skeleton/` 装进你的 profile（二选一）：

```powershell
# A. 由 agent 调用 plugin_manager 工具
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "C:\\path\\to\\dsh-context\\plugin-skeleton" }

# B. 命令行（把 <dsh> 换成你的 dsh 启动器完整路径）
& <dsh> plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-context\plugin-skeleton"
```

重启 Desktop，然后在会话里：

- 发 `/ctx` —— 显示当前会话的 `总用量 / 上下文 / 百分比 / 状态`
- 发 `/ctx 200000` —— 把**本会话**的上下文临时改成 200000 tokens；`/ctx reset` 恢复默认
- 左侧导航的 **`ctx`** —— 整页控制面板：用量/上下文/控制状态、可编辑的全局配置、一键启用自动压缩
- 输入框下方常驻 **`ctx 上下文 …`** 指示器（按插件上下文算百分比，不改 DSH 自带 HUD）
- **工具与提示词清单**：每个工具/提示词 section 可分别用「会话 / 全局」开关决定是否参与请求
- 设置 → **上下文长度** —— 同一块面板
  （装完必须**重启 dsh 进程**；只刷新页面不会加载新插件）

到达上下文后自动压缩需要把控制半侧挂进 agent preset（否则插件只做监控）：

```yaml
- id: ctx-mon-and-con-control
  name: 'ctx-mon-and-con/control'
  config: { mode: idle }
```

详情见 [`plugin-skeleton/README.md`](plugin-skeleton/README.md)。

也可以直接从 GitHub 安装（等价于插件市场上架后的安装命令，已实测可装可启动）：

```powershell
& <dsh> plugin --profile desktop add "github:qiangweiliu/dsh-context#path:/plugin-skeleton"
```

插件市场（dshmarket）目前搜不到本插件：市场只收录 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 精选目录里的条目。
原因与收录步骤见 [`docs/market-submission.md`](docs/market-submission.md)。

卸载与残留实测：`& <dsh> plugin --profile desktop remove ctx-mon-and-con`，
详见 [`scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1`](scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1) 与 [`plugin-skeleton/README.md`](plugin-skeleton/README.md#卸载与残留实测)。

## 关键结论（写插件前先看）

1. **没有请求中间件**：messages 由会话日志派生并冻结；改变历史的合法通道只有压缩协议（`surfaceOp: { op: 'replace' }`）与 `tool/result` replace + 影子价。
2. **Web 形态下自动压缩实例在 preset 里**：`dsh-web-app` 把宿主平面的 `compaction-basic` 置为 `disabled`，真身挂在 `preset-standard` 的 `cordis:group` 内，bundle 层按 id 打不中；调参必须整段覆盖 `preset-standard`（patch 是整体替换，不深合并）。
3. **第三方插件不能裸 import `@deepseek-ai/*`**：宿主包在 `app.asar` 内，只由 DSH 自己的 loader 解析。要么零 import（只用 `ctx` 服务 + 手写 Standard Schema），要么用 esbuild/tsup 打包进产物。
4. **token 计量是固定 4 字符/token 的启发式**：中文与 JSON schema 严重低估，阈值要留 headroom。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-useful-tools · DSH 有用小工具箱

小工具集合插件。**mark_read** 让指定命令（cat/grep/head/sed/awk…）读过的文件自动算已读，
解决官方原生 write/edit 的「cannot modify "…": file has not been read」门禁误伤
（内容明明已经用 grep/脚本等方式看过，原生写仍要求先用 read 工具读一遍）。

## 功能

| 工具 | 参数 | 简介 |
|---|---|---|
| `mark_read` | `commands` `undo` | 配置**读命令集合** + **自动标记钩子**（两者是同一功能）。`commands` 写命令串 / 传文件路径 / 不传用预置清单（`lib/core/mark-read/read-commands.json`）；`undo:true` 撤销。**两种读法都算**：① 宿主工具（如 `grep` 工具）；② `bash` 里跑的命令（`cat a.txt`、`grep x b.txt`）。跨平台别名归一：`Get-Content`/`gc`/`type`/`more` → cat，`Select-String`/`sls`/`findstr` → grep。集合里的命令执行后，钩子（`tools/post-execute`）自动把它读过的**所有文件**补发观测，不用指定文件；配置落盘 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`、每次现读 ⇒ 配置一次永久有效 |
| `sync_plugin` | `write` `profile` `source` `dshHome` `pluginName` `register` | 把插件工作区代码同步到 profile 的 local-plugins。缺省 dryRun，`write:true` 真写；`register:true` 写 profile 的 dependencies + bundles 并注册；`dshHome` 缺省当前实例，指向测试环境即可装进去 |
| `minihost` | `action` `plugin` `port` `path` `method` `body` `services` | **后端模拟**：本地 mini 宿主，把插件服务端代码跑起来。`action=start`（启动）/ `stop`（停止）/ `status`（状态）/ `call`（请求）；`services` 可注入宿主服务（插件依赖 storageDomain/sessions 等真实服务时用） |
| `preview` | `action` `plugin` `spec` `out` `file` `port` `backend` `host` `lan` | **前端模拟**：插件预览页。`action=gen`（生成，无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）/ `serve`（启动，`backend` 可反代真实后端或 minihost；`host=0.0.0.0` 或 `lan:true` 监听局域网并返回 `lanUrl`）/ `stop` / `status` |
| `verify_plugin` | `plugin` `source` `profile` `log` | 验证任意 DSH 插件是否装载成功、工具是否注册（只静态分析，不执行插件代码）。`plugin` 传插件名或根目录，缺省巡检所有已装插件 |
| `test_env` | `action` `kind` `version` `root` `force` `plugin` `pluginName` `dir` `dshBin` | 测试环境（隔离实例）：`action=create`（创建）/ `start`（启动）/ `stop`（停止）/ `status`（状态）。独立 DSH_HOME + 自动端口，随便崩不碰主实例 |

## 用法

```
mark_read commands: "cat,grep,head"        # 加入读命令集合（持久生效）
mark_read                                   # 不传 commands = 用预置清单（20 个常见读文件命令）
mark_read commands: "<命令清单文件路径>"      # 从文件读命令集合（每行/逗号一个）
mark_read commands: "grep" undo: true       # 撤销 grep（从集合移除）

verify_plugin plugin: "dsh-git-push"        # 验单个插件（也可传插件根目录）
verify_plugin                               # 巡检所有已装插件
```

`mark_read` 的语义是**配置「哪些命令算读」**，不是逐个标记文件：集合里的命令执行后，
它读过的**所有文件**自动补发观测（`tools/post-execute` 钩子），不需要指定文件——要指定文件直接 `read` 就行。
集合落盘到 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`，钩子每次现读，所以**配置一次、永久有效**（改完即时生效、重启仍在）。

`verify_plugin` 给三项证据，专治「装完插件发现工具没出现」：

1. **装配结构**（静态读源码）：入口是否存在、是否导出 `apply`、是否有 tools 注册调用、
   `apply` 顶层是否 `return {`（cordis 会判 `Invalid effect` 并卸载整条 fiber，工具全部失效）、
   `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有顶层 `- insert:`。入口用 `export *` 转出的会跟进去看。
2. **部署一致性**：源码根 vs profile 的 local-plugins/node_modules 副本逐文件比内容，
   不一致说明宿主跑的不是你改的代码。
3. **宿主日志**：扫 `did not activate` / `TypeError` 等行；日志早于源码最后修改时间的
   判为修复前的历史记录，降级为提示。

只读文件、不 import 被验证插件——插件模块顶层和 `apply` 都可能带副作用，验证不该把它跑起来。
代价是「注册是否真的成功」仍需宿主内实测（工具是否真的出现在工具清单里），输出里的 `staticOnly`/`notes` 会标注这一点。

## 前后端模拟链路

`minihost` 是**后端模拟**，`preview` 是**前端模拟**，两者通过 `serve` 的 `backend` 参数串成一条链，
全程不碰真实后端：

```
minihost { action: "start", plugin: "<插件根>", port: 31177 }          # ① 起后端（插件服务端代码）
preview  { action: "gen",   plugin: "<插件根>" }                        # ② 生成前端预览页（无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）
preview  { action: "serve", file: "<插件根>/assets/preview.html", backend: "http://<本机IP>:31177" }
                                                                        # ③ 起前端，/api/* 打到 ①
minihost { action: "status" } · preview { action: "status" }            # 查状态
minihost { action: "stop", port: 31177 } · preview { action: "stop", port: 31188 }
```

### minihost 的两个细节

- **路由匹配只看路径**：`/api/xxx?fromIndex=true` 按 `/api/xxx` 匹配，query 留给 handler 自己解析
  （旧实现拿含 query 的完整 URL 比对，任何带参数的接口都会 404）。
- **宿主服务注入**：插件接线依赖真实服务（`storageDomain` / `sessions` / `workspaceRegistry` 等）时，
  传 `services` 指向一个模块——该模块默认导出一个「服务对象」或「返回服务对象的函数」，注入项覆盖同名默认服务：

```
minihost { action: "start", plugin: "<插件根>", port: 31177, services: "<插件根>/test/api/helpers/fake-services.mjs" }
```

`backend` 也可以指向真实 DSH 后端（如 `http://<本机IP>:30800`），此时是「前端模拟 + 真实后端」。

## 测试环境（隔离实例）

起一个与主实例完全隔离的 DSH：独立 `DSH_HOME`、独立端口（3083-3182），里面随便装插件、随便改、随便崩。

```
test_env { action: "status" }                                    # 看两个环境（test/clean）是否存在/运行
test_env { action: "create", plugin: "<插件根>" }                # 创建 <工作区>/<版本>@Save-test 并把插件装进去
test_env { action: "start",  plugin: "<插件根>" }                # 创建（若无）并启动，返回端口
test_env { action: "stop" }                                      # 停止（按端口记录找进程 TERM）
```

`plugin` 可选：给了就把该插件复制进 `profiles/web/node_modules` 并注册到 bundle 列表；不给就是纯裸环境。
环境根优先级：参数 `root` > 环境变量 `DSH_TEST_ENV_ROOT` > 插件配置 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json` 的 `testEnvRoot` > 推算（`DSH_WORKSPACE` / `DSH_HOME` 上一级「工作区」）。**不写死路径**，部署方按配置决定位置。

配合 `sync_plugin` 可以把插件同步 + 注册进这个隔离环境（`dshHome` 指向环境目录即可，缺省是当前实例）：

```
sync_plugin { write: true, register: true, dshHome: "<环境目录>" }
```

## 配置（`<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`）

```json
{
  "observeHook": true,
  "observeTools": ["cat", "grep", "head", "sed", "awk"],
  "testEnvRoot": "<可选，test_env 的环境根>"
}
```

- `observeHook`：自动标记钩子总开关（默认开）
- `observeTools`：读命令集合——**填什么、什么就生效**；钩子每次现读，改动即时生效无需重启
- 也可以直接用 `mark_read` 工具改这个集合（`commands` 加入 / `undo` 撤销）
- 预置清单：`lib/core/mark-read/read-commands.json`（20 个常见读文件命令）

## 语义与边界（实测结论）

- 观测**有效到文件版本再变为止**：版本不变一直放行；文件被任何一方改动后，
  原生写改为报 `file changed since it was read — re-read the file, then retry`，重新标记即可。
- 官方 read 带 offset/limit 只看几行同样算读过 ⇒ 把 grep 纳入与宿主自身尺度一致，不算放权。
- **bash 里跑的命令也算读**（0.1.13 起）：钩子解析命令串（`cat a.txt`、`grep x b.txt`），
  命令名在集合里就标记其文件参数；跨平台别名归一（`Get-Content`/`gc`/`type` → cat，`Select-String`/`sls`/`findstr` → grep）。
  已知边界：`xargs`、`$(...)`、`for` 循环里的文件参数提取不到（启发式解析）。
- 单次钩子调用最多标记 40 个文件（防全仓 grep 观测风暴）。

## 安装

DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2+。装好后需重启 DSH 生效（工具与钩子在启动时装配）。

本插件只注册工具，不提供斜杠指令（原因与恢复条件见契约 C-204）。

## 文档

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | 门面：简介、工具表、用法、配置、安装、目录结构、版本记录 |
| `docs/CONTRACT.md` | 契约：命名 / 装配 / 部署 / 依赖 / 验证 / 测试 / 版本的硬约束，实现与验收的唯一依据 |
| `docs/NOT-DONE.md` | 未实现能力与原因（预览页截图 / 自包含快照 / shell 启动器），含未来若做的形态 |

## 目录结构（目录即工具名 · 一个文件夹一个工具）

```
lib/
├── index.js                 装配入口：扫描 lib/shared/* 动态注册（工具名取文件夹名）
├── shared/                  工具适配层 —— 新增工具只需新建一个文件夹，不必改装配
│   ├── mark_read/index.js    → 工具 mark_read
│   ├── sync_plugin/index.js  → 工具 sync_plugin
│   ├── minihost/index.js     → 工具 minihost   （action=start|call|stop|list|status）
│   ├── preview/index.js      → 工具 preview    （action=gen|serve|stop|list|status）
│   ├── verify_plugin/index.js → 工具 verify_plugin（验证任意插件的装载与工具注册，只静态分析）
│   └── test_env/index.js     → 工具 test_env（测试环境：create/start/stop/status）
└── core/                    共享实现（不含注册逻辑）
    ├── mark-read/           观测补发 + 台账 + 自动标记钩子
    ├── plugin-sync/         同步实现（CLI 同款）+ profile 探测 + 原子拷贝 + 注册
    ├── minihost/            主进程 host.mjs + 每请求子进程 host-child.mjs
    ├── preview/             DSH 根/UMD 自探测 + 单文件 HTML 壳 + 静态服务（含 /api 反代）
    ├── verify-plugin/       静态分析（入口/apply/注册调用）+ 部署一致性 + 宿主日志
    └── test-env/            隔离实例：环境骨架 / 启停 / 端口探测 / 状态
```

**设计契约**：命名、装配、部署、依赖、验证、测试、版本等硬约束见 [docs/CONTRACT.md](docs/CONTRACT.md)
（实现与验收的唯一依据）。新增工具只需新建 `lib/shared/<名字>/index.js` 并导出 `{ description, parameters, run }`。

## 预览页（统一管理 · 主题插件除外）

```
通用件（本插件）  lib/core/preview/：DSH 根与 DSH_HOME 自探测 · React UMD 缓存 · 单文件 HTML 壳
                  · 静态服务 + /api 反代 · 进程台账（.preview/instances.json）· 通用自动挂载垫片
插件自持          assets/preview.spec.mjs（可选增强：自定义垫片 harness / 假数据 / 首屏注入 post / 输出路径）
                 └ 默认字段：{ title, css, harness, body, post, client, output }
主题插件          允许完全自持预览（皮肤注入与真实渲染强耦合，不走本工具）
```

```bash
# 工具（一个 preview 工具，动作走 action 参数）
preview { action: "gen",   plugin: "<插件根>", spec?, out? }        # 生成单文件 preview.html（无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）
preview { action: "serve", file: "<preview.html>", port?, backend? } # 起服务；给 backend 则 /api/* 反代真实后端
preview { action: "stop",  port | file }
preview { action: "status" }                                        # 存活实例（等价 list）
```

实测（2026-10-17）：dsh-session-conductor 无 spec → gen 1.28MB → serve 200 → `#root` 渲染出真实界面（5 个插槽、0 错误）；
dsh-skill-scoreboard 修复 TDZ 后同样渲染成功。

## 版本记录

| 版本 | 变更 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.17 | 新增单测 CI：`.github/workflows/test.yml`，push 到 master 与所有 PR 触发，Node 20/22/24 矩阵跑 `node --test test/*.mjs`（测试零依赖，无需 npm install）。 |
| 0.1.16 | 修 `sync_plugin`

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-study-note

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns explicitly opted-in conversations into structured Markdown study notes. Each conversation starts with recording off; enabling one conversation does not enable another.

## Quick start — tutorial

Requires Node.js 22.19+ and a DSH profile providing `commands`, `sessions`, and `llm`. Loader composition is tested against the installed DSH 0.1.0-rc.8 and the local 0.1.1-rc.2 build. Later releases are not yet verified. The package contains executable JavaScript and needs no install-time build.

1. Clone the plugin, install development dependencies, and create an installable archive:

   ```sh
   git clone https://github.com/WaterFountain-Jack/dsh-study-note.git
   cd dsh-study-note
   npm install
   npm pack
   ```

2. Install into your intended profile. This changes that profile; replace `desktop` if yours has another name. This package is not published to npm, so installing by npm name will not work.

   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD/dsh-study-note-0.1.0.tgz"
   dsh --profile desktop --dump-config
   ```

3. Restart that DSH profile if it has not hot-loaded the plugin. In a conversation, run the commands below as separate messages, then ask a learning question and let the assistant finish its answer:

   ```text
   /note on Cordis
   /note status
   ```

4. Recording runs in the background after a complete answer. `/note sync` checks all completed eligible turns immediately and retries pending failures; `/note status` reports the file and latest error. Verify the generated document and root index in the configured notes directory. Disable this conversation with `/note off`.

Uninstalling preserves notes and local state:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-study-note
```

## Conversation controls — reference

| Command | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `/note on [topic]` | Enable this conversation; process only complete turns that begin after enabling. Repeating it does not reset the checkpoint. |
| `/note off` | Cancel and await background work, retain existing files. After success no new automatic writes occur for this conversation. |
| `/note status` | Show switch, directory, topic, file, pending work, and latest error. |
| `/note sync` | Process eligible completed turns now; requires recording on. Does not backfill the off interval. |
| `/note topic <topic>` | Pin a topic and move this conversation's existing note; rebuild the index. |
| `/note reindex` | Rebuild the plugin-owned root index, without a model call; also available while off. |
| `/note new` | Clear the association only after the old note is deleted or moved outside the root; leaves recording off. Use `on` for a fresh start without historical backfill. |

Topics contain 1–64 letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. A pinned topic can create a directory; automatic topic selection only uses existing directories, falling back to `inbox`. Subagent conversations cannot opt in.

## Notes and index — reference

```text
~/.dsh/study-notes/
├── README.md
├── Cordis/
│   └── 2026-10-15-Cordis-学习-<session-hash>.md
├── inbox/
└── .study-note/
    ├── state.json
    ├── writer.lock
    └── requests/
```

One document belongs to one conversation. A relevant question creates a section containing the question, one-line conclusion, explanation, formula/code/example, an AI-drafted understanding for you to rewrite, unresolved questions, and source turn/event numbers. Follow-ups can update an existing section; unrelated questions add sections. Notes do not certify correctness or mastery.

Hand-edited sections are not replaced: related follow-ups append a supplemental section instead. Preserve the HTML metadata and section markers. Renames and moves within the root are discovered on the next write or `/note reindex`; external edits are not watched continuously. Deleting a note does not silently recreate it. Keep one copy per conversation inside the root.

Only the region between `<!-- dsh-study-note:index:start -->` and `<!-- dsh-study-note:index:end -->` is maintained in `README.md`. Handwritten entries outside that region stay unchanged. Only this plugin's documents join its index; existing unrelated notes are not rewritten or automatically cataloged.

## Configuration — reference

The bundle entry id is `study-note`. An optional overlay selects a different root:

```yaml
- id: study-note
  config:
    notesDir: '~/study-notes'
```

Save the overlay at a path you choose and pass `--patch <absolute-overlay-path>` when launching the profile. Alternatively merge the entry into your profile patch, preserving other entries. This project does not change your active profile or existing knowledge base.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notesDir` | `~/.dsh/study-notes` | Absolute path or `~/` path; choose a separate directory for each simultaneous DSH process. |
| `debounceMs` | `1500` | Delay after a completed turn before background processing. |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Auxiliary request deadline, including its audit write. |
| `provider`, `model` | absent | Supply both non-empty strings to override; otherwise reuse the completed answer's route. |
| `maxInputBytes` | `98304` | UTF-8 limit for the entire framed auxiliary request; oversize fails visibly. |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `65536` | Limit for serialized stream chunks, not only final text. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `4000` | Auxiliary output-token cap. |
| `recentSections` | `6` | Most recent note sections supplied as follow-up context. |
| `maxMessageChars` | `12000` | Per question, answer, or section text limit; truncation is explicitly marked. |

## Privacy, cost, and failures — reference

Never-enabled conversations produce no recording files or auxiliary model calls. Recording selects human-origin text and the last complete assistant text from future completed turns; it excludes reasoning blocks, tool results, images, injected user messages, and interrupted output. Exact routine acknowledgements and progress questions are filtered locally; other irrelevant turns may still require a model call to decide to skip.

Each eligible turn can cause an additional paid request to the configured provider, including skipped content. Only one request runs at a time per conversation; different conversations may run concurrently. Prior note sections, including your edits in those sections, can enter these requests. The plugin does not read API keys or ambient environment values, but does not redact secrets that you typed into conversation text. Do not enable it for sensitive conversations unless that provider and local retention are acceptable.

Before dispatch, the exact system prompt, messages, route, token limit, and source event numbers are written to `.study-note/requests/`. These local audit files retain selected conversation text even if the model skips the turn or recording is then disabled. New files use owner-only permissions; they are not encrypted and existing parent permissions are not tightened. Disabling or uninstalling does not erase files; there is no automatic retention cleanup.

The auxiliary request is not inserted into the main model history or DSH session log. The tested host cannot safely register external informational session events, so replay requires keeping the plugin audit directory alongside the DSH conversation log. No shell command or model tool executes during recording.

Model errors, invalid JSON, truncation finishes, missing files, malformed markers, and permissions errors are reported by `/note status` and runtime logs. Fix the cause and use `/note sync`; failed model work may be billed again on retry. Note, state, and index are separate atomic file replacements, not one transaction; an index failure may leave a saved note, and sync rebuilds without regenerating that committed turn. A crash can cause duplicate model billing but note metadata prevents duplicate committed sections on recovery. Filesystem rename durability across sudden power loss is not guaranteed.

Only one writer may hold a notes directory. A crash may leave `.study-note/writer

plugins.description: 配置文件审计：.env 有没有被提交、权限对不对、里面是不是明文
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-env-audit

**在你把密钥提交进 git 之前，先看一眼 `.env` 本身。**

**关键词**：配置文件审计 · .env 检查 · 密钥进 git · 文件权限 · 明文密码 · gitignore · 环境变量 · .env.example · 配置与代码分离

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：只盯**环境配置文件本身**的四件事 —— 会不会被提交、权限宽不宽、里面是不是明文、有没有模板。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是密钥扫描器** —— 扫**代码里的密钥字面量**（`sk-...`、AKIA...）是 `dsh-secret-scan` 的活
- ❌ **不是密钥管理工具** —— 它不存密钥、不轮换、不加密
- ❌ **不是运行时防护** —— 不拦读取，只做静态审计
- ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只描述事实，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：
```
secret-scan = 代码里有没有写死密钥
env-audit   = 配置文件本身有没有把密钥暴露出去
```

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `ENV-NOT-IGNORED` | `.gitignore` / `.git/info/exclude` 里没有忽略 `.env`，而项目里有凭据型环境配置 | 🔴 |
| `ENV-PLAINTEXT` | `.env` 里 `PASSWORD=` / `SECRET=` / `TOKEN=` / `API_KEY=` 跟的是明文而非占位符 | 🔴 |
| `ENV-FILE-PERM` | `.env` 权限宽于 `600`（同机器其他用户可读）| 🟡 |
| `ENV-NO-EXAMPLE` | 有环境配置内容，却找不到 `.env.example` / `.env.sample` 模板 | 🔵 |
| `ENV-HARDCODED-CONFIG` | 源码里硬编码内网/私有网段地址或 `.internal` 主机名 | 🔵 |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、证据、依据（可查证的标准/文档）、以及怎么办。**

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-env-audit
```

## 用法

```bash
# 审计当前目录
dsh-env-audit

# 审计指定目录
dsh-env-audit --root /path/to/project

# 看内置演示（一个「.env 没忽略 + 644 + 明文密码 + 没有模板」的项目）
dsh-env-audit --demo

# 列出规则与依据
dsh-env-audit --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告（可截图归档）
dsh-env-audit --root . --html env-audit.html

# 挂 CI：有 high 命中时退出码 1
dsh-env-audit --quiet --json
```

---

## 一个真实的例子

`--demo` 那个样本项目的一切看起来都很正常：有 `package.json`、有 `src/`、有 `.gitignore`。

`dsh-env-audit` 看见的：

```
🔴 .gitignore 没忽略 .env，且有凭据型环境配置            .gitignore
🔴 .env 明文：DB_PASSWORD=      （报告只到等号为止）   .env:10
🔴 .env 明文：STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=                      .env:14
🔴 .env 明文：JWT_SECRET=                             .env:15
🔴 .env 明文：SMTP_PASSWORD=                          .env:16
🟡 .env 权限 644 超过上限 600                          .env
🔵 有凭据型环境配置，却找不到 .env.example 模板         .env.example
🔵 源码硬编码内网地址 10.0.3.12                        src/db.js:4
```

**这 8 条，`git add .` 之前就能看见。**

---

## 关于「明文」这条规则的两个设计取舍

1. **报告里不会出现你的密钥值。** 正则只吃到 `KEY=` 为止，值是用零宽断言「验证存在」的 —— 所以证据栏永远是 `DB_PASSWORD=` 这个样子。工具自己不能变成泄露源。
2. **占位符不算。** `空值`、`${DB_PASSWORD}`、`<generate-with-openssl-rand>`、`your_xxx`、`changeme`、`xxx`、`test`、`example` 这类写法会被跳过。

## 边界（说清楚做不到什么）

- **不知道 `.env` 是不是「已经」提交过** —— 核心引擎是离线文件扫描，不读 git 索引。规则报的是「当前 `.gitignore` 没忽略它」，以及「忽略它不等于已提交的历史被清掉」。已提交过的情况请用 `git log --all -- .env` 自查。
- **权限规则只在 POSIX（Linux/macOS）上有意义** —— Windows 没有这套权限位；若在 Windows 上跑，`600` 的比较结果不可用。
- **`ENV-NOT-IGNORED` 和 `ENV-NO-EXAMPLE` 有「适用门槛」** —— 引擎的 `when` 门槛是「某处存在形如 `...PASSWORD=` / `SECRET=` / `TOKEN=` / `API_KEY=` / `CREDENTIAL=` 的赋值行」。带来两个后果：
  - 只写小写键名、或只含 `NODE_ENV` / `PORT` 这类无凭据项的环境文件，**不会**触发这两条（报告里会标为「因不适用未运行」）
  - 非 `.env` 的配置文件（`.ini`、`.properties` 等）里出现同形状的凭据赋值时，**也会**触发 —— 因为 `when` 门槛看不到文件名。此时标题只陈述「没有忽略 .env」和「有凭据型环境配置」两个事实，不宣称 `.env` 一定存在
- **明文规则只认常见的高危键名**（PASSWORD / PASSWD / SECRET / TOKEN / API_KEY / ACCESS_KEY / PRIVATE_KEY / CREDENTIAL）—— 自定义键名（如 `FOO=真实密钥`）不报。
- **`ENV-NOT-IGNORED` 是「整仓库任一 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `.env` 就算过」** —— 语义是「仓库里有没有忽略 .env 的地方」。这符合 gitignore 可叠加的实际行为；代价是：多包仓库里如果只有某一个子目录的 `.gitignore` 写了 `.env`，就不会报（单一根 `.gitignore` 的项目不受影响）。
- **只看 `.env` 系列文件** —— `config.json`、`settings.yaml` 里的明文凭据不归它管。
- **硬编码地址规则是低优先提示** —— 内网地址写在代码里不一定有问题，它只是违反「配置与代码分离」，报出来让你确认。

## 依据

每条规则的 `source` 都能查到原文：

- [OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Secrets_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html) —— 凭据不应进入版本控制；密钥应对最小范围可读；要让使用者清楚需要哪些配置项
- [The Twelve-Factor App · III. Config](https://12factor.net/config) —— 「配置与代码严格分离」，并明确指出配置文件「很容易被误提交进仓库」
- [Git · gitignore 官方文档](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitignore) —— 用 `.gitignore` 声明哪些文件不纳入版本控制

---


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

# dsh-plugin-auto-compact

> 上下文占用到 **50%** 就自动压缩 —— DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。
> Auto-compact a DSH session at **50%** context usage.

[![CI](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

---

## 1. 这个插件干什么

把 DSH 的自动压缩阈值从出厂 **80%** 改成 **50%**，而且**四处一起改**：宿主平面一行 + `standard` / `cordis` / `ptc` 三个会话预设各一行（会话真正跑的是预设里 `isolate` 出来的独立实例，只改宿主那一行不起作用）。

装完「插件」页会多一张卡片「**上下文自动压缩**」，可开关、可卸载。

- 256K 窗口 ⇒ 约 **131k token** 触发压缩（出厂约 188k）
- 压缩引擎是 DSH 内置的，本插件只决定"以什么参数启用它"

## 2. 为什么需要它（痛点）

> 几个会话同时开着，其中一个**在我还没来得及压缩**的时候就跑满了 —— 窗口继续不了，只能**再开一个新窗口**。
> 可新窗口不知道旧窗口发生过什么：项目背景、试过的方案、刚跑通的命令、你上次纠正我的地方，全都没了。
> 只好把同样的上下文再交代一遍、命令再跑一遍，**重复的输入和重复的工具调用还要重新计费**。

根因：DSH 的自动压缩**只在"步骤边界"检查**（`agent/pre-step`，每个步骤开始前量一次），而一个重步骤
（批量读文件、长命令输出、大 diff）能在单步之内把余量吃光 —— 80% 的阈值常常来不及救。降到 50%，
就是永远给"一个重步骤"留出整块空间。

详细复盘与讨论 → **[Issue #1](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/issues/1)**（欢迎补充你的场景）

## 3. 怎么用

### 安装

「**插件 → + 添加插件**」→ 填下面任意一种 → 安装 → **重启 DSH**（档案补丁不热重载）：

| 填什么 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact` | 仓库地址，需要能访问 GitHub |
| 克隆下来的**绝对路径** | 任何网络都能用：`git clone https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact.git`（https 被重置时改用 `git clone git@github.com:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact.git`） |

重启后「插件 → **已安装**」出现卡片即成功。**关掉卡片开关 = 回到 DSH 出厂默认（80%）**，卸载则连同依赖一起移除。

### 验证（可选，推荐）

```bash
npm test            # 8 项结构自检，零依赖，裸 clone 就能跑
npm run preflight   # 用 DSH 自己的 loader 组合 profile，确认本插件的层赢了
```

> 你的 DSH 版本和作者的不同？先跑 `npm run regen` 再 preflight，让预设覆盖从你自己本机的 DSH 重新生成。

手动登记到 profile、给别人安装、升级 DSH 之后怎么同步、兼容性说明 —— 都在 [**docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md**](./docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md)。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。`cordis.patch.yml` 里三段预设声明整份复制自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`（MIT，© DeepSeek）。

---

## English

- **What it does**: turns DSH's built-in context compaction on at **50%** instead of the shipped 80% — on the host plane *and* inside the `standard` / `cordis` / `ptc` presets, because a session actually runs the preset's isolated engine. A card appears on the Plugins page; switch it off to return to stock behaviour.
- **Why it exists**: DSH checks usage only at *step boundaries* (`agent/pre-step`), so one heavy step — bulk file reads, a long command output, a big diff — can fill the window before compaction fires. You then open a fresh session with no memory of the old one, re-explain everything, and pay for every repeated input and tool call again. Compacting at 50% always leaves a full heavy step of room. Full write-up: [Issue #1](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/issues/1).
- **How to use**: Plugins → *Add plugin* → `github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact`, or clone the repo and paste the local path → restart DSH. Verify with `npm test` / `npm run preflight`; run `npm run regen` first if your DSH version differs.
- More detail: [docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md](./docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md). License: MIT.

# dsh-pdf-render

**一句话**：把 PDF 的指定页渲染成 PNG——**让模型亲眼看见**版式、表格与图表，而不是只读文本层。 **为什么值得用**：PDF 的文本层常常丢版式（多栏被读成一行、表格错位、图表完全丢失）。把页面渲染成图再走多模态读图，是「**亲眼看**」而不是「听转述」。本机没有 poppler / ghostscript，所以走已装的 `pypdfium2`——**依赖少一个是一个**。 ## 工具 - `pdf_render`：把 PDF 的指定页渲染为 PNG 并返回文件路径（不返回像素：看图请用 read_image / vision_ask）。pages 支持 1 / 1-3 / 2,5 / all。 ## 生态契约 > 依据《DSH 插件生态倡议书》三条原则：**组合优先 / 声明清晰 / 兼容优先**。 - **依赖 service**（`inject`）：`tools` —— 组合行装载时等待这些 service - **贡献面**：工具 `pdf_render`；slot 无；service 无 - 组合行 id：`agent-pdf-render` - **Fabric manifest**：`dsh-plugin.json`（RFC 0001 v0.1 **Draft** 形状）——`id` = `com.jonah791.pdf-render`，required = （无），optional = （无） - **Fabric 入口**：`src/fabric.ts` → `lib/fabric.js`（骨架，**不依赖 DSH/Cordis**；Fabric SDK 发布后填充实现） > ⚠ **不是认证**：Fabric 目前只有文档草案（无正式 schema、无 SDK、无 conformance 套件），因此**不得**声称本插件 > 「通过 Fabric 认证」或「已符合 Fabric 标准」。对齐的是 RFC 0001 的 manifest 形状 + 可机械校验的明文规则； > `dsh-plugin.json` 的 `$schema` 是**自证 draft 的占位**，Phase 0 发布 canonical identifier 后替换。 组合片段（`cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - insert: - id: agent-pdf-render name: dsh-pdf-render config: {} ``` ## 能力边界（诚实声明） 本插件与宿主**同进程、全权限**运行。「能力声明」用于兼容判断、用户确认与审计，**不构成安全沙箱**——不要把它当权限边界。 本插件不导入其他插件或宿主的内部路径（组合优先），也不覆盖别人的内部实现。 ### 两个面，别混淆 - **Fabric 契约面**：`dsh-plugin.json` + `src/fabric.ts`（host entrypoint）。这是**前瞻声明**——Fabric 目前只有 RFC Draft， 没有正式 schema / SDK / conformance 套件，官方 `docs/plugin-development.md` 明示其**尚不能作为依赖或发布目标**； `$schema` 是自证 draft 的 `.invalid` 占位（RFC §14-1 未定 canonical identifier），**不是** schema 校验通过，也**不是**认证。 - **DSH/Cordis 面（非标准扩展路径）**：`src/index.ts` + `cordis.patch.yml`——本插件**现在真正可运行**的形态。 `tools` 不在 Fabric v0.1 的 capability 表内（v0.1 只有 host.info / log / 生命周期取消 + `storage.local` / `commands` / `messages.observe`）， 故这属标准之外的扩展路径：**不得**当作可移植 API，也**不得**成为 Fabric entrypoint 的依赖。 ## 构建与挂载 ```sh pnpm build # 挂载到 web profile（dsh plugin-manager 或 plugin_mount） ``` ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-pdf-render": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-pdf-render" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: agent-pdf-render name: dsh-pdf-render config: {} ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`pdf_render {path: "<某个 PDF>", pages: "1"}` → 应返回 **PNG 文件路径**（不是像素、不是 base64）；再用 `read_image` 打开它 → 应看见该页版式。 ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `outDir` | `$DSH_HOME/_tmp_review/pdf-render` | 渲染输出目录 | | `scale` | `1.5` | 渲染倍率（2.0 更清晰但文件更大） | ## 落盘与自证 | 文件 | 何时写 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `/-p.png` | 每次 `pdf_render` | 该页的 PNG（返回的是**路径**） | **一条命令答五问**：`ls -la ` → ① 渲染产物在不在 ② 谁的（文件名含源 PDF 名）③ 哪一页（`-p`）④ 质量（文件大小与倍率）⑤ 时间（mtime）。 ## 生效判据与回退 **判据**：行为级——`pdf_render` 返回路径且该文件存在、能被 `read_image` 打开。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 已渲染的 PNG 留在 `outDir`，可手工清理。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-pdf-render && npm test ``` **31 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖 pages 解析（`1` / `1-3` / `2,5` / `all` 与非法输入）· 路径与输出命名 · **文件不存在 ⇒ 响亮失败**（不是空图）。无需网络。 ## 设计要点 - **只返回路径**：不返回像素、不返回 base64——看图是 `read_image` / `vision_ask` 的职责（**职责单一**，且避免把二进制塞进上下文）。 - **pages 解析是纯函数**：`src/range.ts` 无 IO，可离线单测（31 条里大半在这一层）。 - **走 pypdfium2 而非 pdftoppm**：本机没有 poppler / ghostscript——**依赖少一个是一个**。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **感知层**） - 相关技能：`document-processing`（PDF/Word/Excel/PPT 的本机处理配方） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

plugins.description: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
plugins.readme_text:
中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.4**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。已在最新版 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 实测：三形态接入（原生一等工具 / web_search seam / wide_research）均可正常启用。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用引擎 | | **Chrome** | ❌ 可选 | 页面截图、JS 渲染页、登录态抓取 | 截图工具不可用，其余正常 | | **pdfplumber / PyMuPDF** | ❌ 可选 | PDF 提取 | argo_pdf 不可用，其余正常 | | **Playwright** | ❌ 可选 | 截图增强 | 截图工具回退 Chrome CDP，其余正常 | 安装脚本（install.sh）只自动装前两个；其余可选依赖按需 `pip install` 或 `brew install` 即可。 更稳、完全不依赖 Node 的写法：先装脚本（方式一），再指向本机 Py

plugins.description: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): all 15 Coding Plan models with per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.
plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan

火山方舟 **Ark Coding Plan** 的 provider 路由，用于 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**。

**收录全部 15 个 Coding Plan 模型，每个模型可调思考强度，元数据对着线上端点实测。**

> Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness.

---

## 与已有方案的区别

| | 官方 `ark-plan-api` | 本包 |
|---|---|---|
| Coding Plan 模型 | 8 个 | **15 个** |
| 思考强度开关 | 无 | **每模型可调** |
| 清单维护 | 手写 | **单一数据源 + 每周漂移检测** |
| 元数据 | 未标注 | **实测 + 日期** |

官方缺的 7 个：`deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`kimi-k3`、`ark-code-latest`、`glm-5.3-flash`、
`doubao-seed-2.1-lite`、`doubao-seed-2.0-mini`、`kimi-k2.8-preview`。

---

## 前置条件

1. 已安装 DSH（0.2.0-rc 或更新）
2. 已开通**火山方舟 Coding Plan 订阅**并拿到 API Key

> ⚠️ 本包不含任何密钥。

---

## ⚠️ 装之前先看这一条

本包**整体替换** `llm-pi-ai` 这一行的 `config`（DSH 的 patch 语义是「整体替换、不深合并」）。

- **在设置页 / `settings.yaml` 里配过别的 provider** → 不受影响（那里是深合并）。
- **在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手写过 pi-ai provider** → 会被替换，请先合并：

  ```sh
  node scripts/merge.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/<你的 profile>/cordis.patch.yml
  ```

  默认**只打印**结果；确认无误后加 `--write` 落盘（会先备份 `.bak-merge-<时间戳>`）。
  合并助手只做文本级插入，**你的注释会保留**；键冲突时保留你原来的值，不会静默覆盖。

---

## 安装

### 方式 1：命令行（从 GitHub）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:STLI69/coding-plan
```

### 方式 2：插件市场

在市场里搜索 `coding-plan`，点安装。

### 方式 3：本地目录

在 **设置 → 插件 → 安装 bundle** 里指向本包目录。

装完**重启 DSH**。

---

## 填入 API Key

打开 **设置 → 模型（Models）**，找到 `Ark Coding Plan`，点编辑填入 Key。
本包声明的凭据引用名是 `ARK_CODING_PLAN_CN_API_KEY`。

---

## 模型与实测数据

**实测日期：2026-10-16**（方法：`node scripts/probe.mjs`，对着线上端点逐个模型打真实请求）

| 模型 | maxTokens | 图片输入 | 思考档位 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `doubao-seed-2.1-pro` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.1-lite` | 262144 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.1-turbo` | 262144 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-evolving` | 262144 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-lite` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-mini` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `glm-5.3` | 131072 | ❌ | low/high/max |
| `glm-5.3-flash` | 131072 | ✅ | low/high/max |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `deepseek-v4-flash` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `minimax-m3` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `kimi-k2.8-preview` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `kimi-k3` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `ark-code-latest` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |

- `maxTokens` 的档位粒度是 65536 / 131072 / 262144 / 393216：表中是**被端点接受的最高档**。
- `glm-5.3` 与 `glm-5.3-flash` **没有 `off`**：这两个模型关掉思考会 HTTP 400，所以不提供该档位。
- 思考 token 计入输出用量，调高思考档位会显著推高 output 消耗。

### 诚实性说明

> 本包只发布能实测的东西。
>
> **实测的**：每个模型可达、被接受的 `maxTokens` 上限、是否接受图片输入 —— 方法见
> `scripts/probe.mjs`，日期见上表。
>
> **未实测的**：`contextWindow`。验证它需要发送超长 prompt，成本不可控，所以表中没有列出，
> 它在 `models.yml` 里只作为**声明值**存在。
>
> **故意不做的**：Agent Plan / 后付费 / BytePlus 路由。我们没有这些端点的 key，无法验证，
> 因此不写进描述 —— 把没验证过的路由写进去，是收录规则里最容易被退回的一件事。
>
> **怎么保持不过期**：`models.yml` 是唯一数据源，每周 GitHub Action 自动探测模型下架与新品上线
> （候选清单在 `watchlist.yml`，人工维护，不保证覆盖所有新模型）。

---

## 为什么只有一个 patch

DSH 的 patch 语义是「整体替换、不深合并」，所以本包只能**覆盖** `llm-pi-ai` 那一行。

早期版本试过「`insert` 一个同插件的第二行」，**已实测证伪**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 会
无条件把整套 catalog 注册进 `dsh-llm` 的**单例** configurable-provider 目录，第二个实例必然报：

```
llm-pi-ai-ark-coding (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai): LlmError:
  configurable provider "amazon-bedrock" is already declared
```

而 `dsh-base` 总是先挂一行 `llm-pi-ai`，所以第二行在任何机器（含全新 profile）都无法激活，
与 provider 名字是否重名无关。

---

## 维护者

```sh
npm ci                 # 装 devDependency（js-yaml）
npm test               # 跑测试
npm run check          # 断言 cordis.patch.yml 与 models.yml 同步
npm run generate       # 改完 models.yml 后重新生成

# 实测并把结果写回 models.yml（需 ARK_CODING_PLAN_CN_API_KEY）
node scripts/probe.mjs --write

# 探测 watchlist 里的候选模型是否已上线
node scripts/probe.mjs --watchlist
```

改模型请**只改 `models.yml`**，然后 `npm run generate`。`cordis.patch.yml` 是生成物。

---

## 许可

MIT
