# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness settings panel: MCP server status + probe, session skills, and hook configs in one native-styled page
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-harness-panel

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a **Harness** page to Settings — one place to inspect and start/stop MCP servers, enable/disable skills, and start/stop hook bridges, styled to match the native settings UI.

English · [中文](#中文)

## Features

**MCP**

- Every configured `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row: connection status (observed from the upstream `mcp/status` seam, honestly `unknown` when unobserved), transport, sanitized target, tool inventory
- A native start/stop switch on every addressable row, through the same `pluginManager` Remote the built-in Plugins page uses; disabling stops the mcp-client row and its tools
- One-shot connectivity probe per server (streamable-http `initialize` POST / stdio spawn handshake, 10s deadline)
- Env/header values never leave the host (keys only, URLs credential-redacted)

**Skills**

- The current session's user-invocable skill catalog — the same seam the composer `/` menu reads (`remote.skills`), so the panel always agrees with the composer
- A native enable/disable switch per skill. Disabling sets the provider's own frontmatter keys (`user-invocable: false`, `disable-model-invocation: true`) in the skill's SKILL.md, so it leaves the model catalog and the `/` menu in every registry scope; the panel keeps listing it with an off switch, and re-enabling restores the original frontmatter lines
- Search filter, model-invocable badge, source path

**Hooks**

- Mounted hook bridges (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-codex`): each row's `configPath` file parsed into event → matcher → command views
- A per-command switch inside each expanded group: turning one hook off flips its `type` to the sentinel the bridges skip, records the original value, and reloads the bridge row so it takes effect immediately. The bridge row itself deliberately carries no whole-row switch — the loader's live re-enable of a row is unreliable, so the page stays at the granularity the file edit serves
- Conventional on-disk locations (`~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.codex/hooks.json`, project-level, …) scanned read-only and clearly marked **not mounted**

## Design

The visual language follows the shipped settings sections rather than inventing its own: `--dsw-*` design tokens only (no hard-coded colors), native corner radii (`--dsw-radius-xl` cards, `--dsw-radius-md` controls), 0.5px hairline strokes, the underline tab strip used by the built-in Plugins page, and the shipped `Switch` atom from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — the exact control the Plugins page uses. Light and dark themes both work.

## Install

Desktop profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`):

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
# package.json → dependencies: "dsh-harness-panel": "link:<path to this repo>"
# package.json → dsh.profile.bundles: add "dsh-harness-panel"
pnpm install
# restart DSH (the desktop profile has no live reload)
```

Or install by local path from Settings → Plugins.

## Security boundary

- MCP and hook bridge switches call the shipped `remote.pluginManager.setPluginEnabled`: the official manager writes the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and reloads the row, exactly as the built-in Plugins page does. This host half registers no write route for them
- The host half adds one write route, `POST /harness-panel/skills/toggle`, for skill toggles. It requires `content-type: application/json`, an `x-harness-panel: 1` header, and a same-origin `Origin` when the browser sends one; the body is bounded to 16 KiB. A toggle edits only the two invocation keys of the named skill's own SKILL.md (verified against the file's declared name) and records the original lines for restore
- Beside those two frontmatter lines, the only file the host writes is `$DSH_HOME/harness-panel/state.json` (default `~/.dsh/harness-panel/state.json`): skill names, descriptions, paths, disable times, and the original frontmatter lines, mode 0600. No instruction bodies, no credentials
- Credentials never leave the host: env/header maps surface as key lists, URLs and error text are redacted
- Routes bind to loopback only (the dsh webserver default)

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build       # emits lib/index.js (host ESM) + lib/client.js (browser bundle)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test        # vitest: mcp aggregation, hooks parsing, sanitization, skill file/state, route gate, switch models
```

The scripts prefer `bunx` and fall back to the local Node. On the macOS desktop install the DSH-bundled Node is hardened and cannot load the ad-hoc native rollup/rolldown bindings, so `bunx tsdown` / `bunx vitest run` is the path that works there.

Compatibility: DSH `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` (developed against desktop 0.2.1-rc.1).

---

## 中文

DeepSeek Harness 设置面板插件：在设置导航中新增 **Harness** 入口，集中查看并启停 MCP 服务器、Skills 与 Hooks，视觉与原生设置页一致。

- **MCP**：已配置服务器的连接状态（来自上游 `mcp/status` 事件，无观察时如实显示未知）、传输方式、脱敏目标、工具清单，一键探活；每个可寻址行右侧有原生启停开关，停用后 mcp-client 行与其工具一起下线
- **Skills**：当前会话可见的 skill 目录（与 `/` 菜单同源），每个 skill 右侧有原生启用/停用开关。停用直接写入该 skill SKILL.md 的官方 frontmatter 键（`user-invocable: false`、`disable-model-invocation: true`），在任何 registry scope 都生效，skill 从模型目录与 `/` 菜单消失；面板仍以关闭状态列出，重新启用时按记录还原原始行
- **Hooks**：已挂载的 hook 桥配置解析（事件点 → 匹配器 → 命令），展开后**每条 command 有独立开关**——关闭时把该 hook 的 `type` 改为 bridge 跳过的哨兵值（provider 自身的机制），记录原始值并重载 bridge 行立即生效。bridge 整行不设总开关：loader 对整行的热恢复不可靠，面板停留在文件编辑能服务的粒度。本机约定路径上**未挂载**的配置文件继续只读扫描

安全边界：MCP 与 hook 开关调用 shipped `remote.pluginManager.setPluginEnabled`，由官方 manager 写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 并 reload，与内置 Plugins 页一致；host 只新增一条 skill 开关写入路由 `POST /harness-panel/skills/toggle`，要求 JSON、`x-harness-panel: 1` 与同源 `Origin`，body 上限 16 KiB，且只改目标 SKILL.md 里两个 invocation 键（先校验文件声明的 skill name）。除这两行外，host 唯一直接写出的文件是 `$DSH_HOME/harness-panel/state.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/harness-panel/state.json`，0600），只含 skill 名称、描述、路径、停用时间与原始行记录，不含正文与凭据。路由仅监听 loopback。

开发命令见上文；安装或重新构建后需重启 DSH（desktop profile 无 live reload）。

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 提供可配置的 CIDR 白名单，支持 fake-IP。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-fetch-allowlist

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 内置的 `web_fetch` 会拒绝解析到内网、保留地址段的域名，防止 SSRF 攻击。但这也会导致有内网/透明代理需求的场景下请求失败。
内置插件无法关闭、也无法配置，因此本插件提供一个白名单补丁，支持额外放行一段 CIDR（默认 Clash/mihomo 的 fake-IP 段 `198.18.0.0/15`），其余行为全部沿用内置实现。

## 安装

Plugins → Add plugin，填入：

```
https://github.com/icceey/dsh-web-fetch-allowlist
```

或：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:icceey/dsh-web-fetch-allowlist
```

管理器提示 `restart-required` 时重启或重新启用。

## 行为

- 先走内置 provider 的解析与校验；只有它抛 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` 时，才尝试白名单。
- 命中就返回地址；不命中就把原来的错误原样抛出，错误码不变。
- 超时、大小上限、重定向、代理、NAT64、字符集等全部由内置实现处理，本插件仅在必要时介入和放行白名单。
- 内置 provider 不存在，或 DSH 升级后内部结构变化时，本插件保持安静、什么都不做。

## 配置

> 如果你是用clash/mihomo且没有调整过fakeip配置，安装后就可以使用，应该不需要调整任何配置。

```yaml
- id: web-fetch-allowlist
  name: 'dsh-web-fetch-allowlist'
  config:
    allowCidrs:
      - '198.18.0.0/15'
```

`allowCidrs` 支持 IPv4/IPv6，设置后替换默认值；无配置时读 `DSH_WEB_FETCH_ALLOW_CIDRS`（逗号分隔）。

plugins.description: DSH plugin that cuts model repetition loops mid-stream, prunes them from the session log, and resumes automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-loop-rescue

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue?sort=semver&label=release)](https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20plugin-%E2%89%A50.1.7-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A loop-rescue plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). When the model falls into repetition (`Now. / OK. / Emit. / Producing.` rotations, the same paragraph over and over), it cuts the stream from the inside, **prunes the loop out of what gets written to the session log**, and resumes automatically.

The difference from a plain cut-off: the interrupted message that goes into the next turn's context **contains no loop**, so the model never re-reads its own repetition and carries on repeating.

Requires **DSH 0.1.7 or newer**. Pure JS, no build step.

## Quick start

Use this **or** `@mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard`, not both: with both on, loops get cut twice.

1. **Install**: sidebar **Plugins** → Add plugin, and give it
   ```
   https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue
   ```
   Switch it on.
2. The defaults work as they are. To watch before it acts, set `mode` to `observe` (see Configuration).

From the command line:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue#v0.1.0
```

Restart `dsh web` after a command-line install. No pnpm build scripts need approving.

## Configuration

The defaults work as they are. To change them, write to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- set:
    - id: loop-rescue
      config:
        mode: rescue              # rescue: cut + prune + resume | cut: cut + prune | observe: log only
        watch: both               # both | reasoning | text
        marker: true              # leave a "〔N chars of repeated reasoning removed〕" line where it pruned
        maxConsecutiveRescues: 3  # cap on back-to-back rescues; one normal call resets it
        stallCalls: 3             # nudge after this many reasoning-only calls with no output; 0 = off
        stallMinReasoningChars: 1024
        retryTemperature: 1.0     # temperature for the resume request; unset = unchanged
        retryReasoningEffort: low # reasoning effort for the resume request; unset = unchanged
        retryRequests: 1          # how many requests after a resume use the two settings above
        language: auto            # auto | zh | en
        detector:                 # detection thresholds; rarely need changing
          poolWindow: 30
          poolMinCoverage: 0.75
          cycleMinChars: 600
```

Consider running `mode: observe` for a day or two first, check that every `loop-rescue: ... loop detected` line in the log is a real loop, then switch to `rescue`.

## How it works

When the agent loop assembles an `assistant/message`, each block's final content comes from the `block-end` payload, not from the deltas streamed before it. The plugin wraps the model call in the `llm/stream` waterfall:

1. It runs a streaming detector on every reasoning and text block.
2. On a hit it closes every open block: the looping block is replaced by its content **pruned back to where the loop started** (optionally with a one-line marker), and the stream ends with `stop`.
3. The message written to the log holds only the useful content before the loop. The raw stream is still kept in full in the event's `stream` record, where the trajectory view can show it.
4. Once the turn has really ended (`whenIdle()`), it sends a resume message with a correction via `followup()`.
5. The first N requests after a resume can use a different set of sampling parameters.
6. After the cap on back-to-back rescues it stops resuming and leaves a note.

Why not edit the session afterwards: an `assistant/message` cannot carry `sourceEventSeqs`, so the session surface's replace operation cannot swap one assistant message for another. Pruning at `block-end` is the only way that keeps message roles and tool-call pairing intact.

### Detection rules

| Rule | Catches | Prunes from |
|---|---|---|
| Phrase pool `pool` | ≥75% of the last 30 sentences are a handful of recurring short phrases (in any order) | Back to where that batch of phrases first appeared |
| Verbatim cycle `cycle` | The tail is the same text repeated verbatim, period 16–4000 chars, ≥3 repeats, ≥600 chars in total | Keeps the first copy, prunes from the second |

Guarding against false positives:

- A Chinese full stop always ends a sentence; an English period only when followed by whitespace.
- Symbol-only lines (`|---|`, `}`) are not counted.
- List items, table rows and quote lines in the text are not counted.
- The inside of ``` code blocks in the text is skipped entirely.
- The phrase pool needs at least two different phrases rotating.
- It never cuts while an open block holds a tool call: closing a half-written tool call would make the host run it with incomplete arguments.

## Offline scan

Replay past sessions through the same detector the plugin uses, to see where it would cut:

```powershell
node tools/scan-session.mjs <session file or directory>          # hits only
node tools/scan-session.mjs <session file or directory> --all    # hits and misses
node tools/scan-session.mjs <session file> --json
```

Reads plain jsonl and zstd-compressed session files (zstd needs Node 22.15+). The script only depends on `src/detector.js` and runs on plain node.

## Cleaning loops already in the history

The plugin only stops new loops; loops already committed to the history keep being imitated by the model. What DSH sends the model is a frozen projection of the session log, which a plugin cannot change, so the session files have to be cleaned offline **with DSH fully closed**. This works for old sessions that never had the plugin too.

The recommended tool is [dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-session-manager) (`dsm loops`, a single-file exe on Windows): the same detection rules, plus upgrading, archiving and repairing broken sessions.

This repository also ships a lightweight script (Node 22.15+, v4 sessions only):

```powershell
node tools/clean-session.mjs            # list sessions with loops, pick by number; Enter = newest
node tools/clean-session.mjs --dry-run  # show what would change
node tools/clean-session.mjs --undo     # restore from the backup
```

- On Windows you can also double-click `tools\clean-session.cmd`, or drop a session folder onto it; if it cannot find the data directory, pass `--data <data directory>`.
- Only matching `assistant/message` events change: text and reasoning are cut back to where the loop started, `data.stream` is cut to match, and the message's `source.replayState` is removed. Every other line stays byte-for-byte the same.
- It backs up to `<data directory>\sessions-loop-rescue-backup\` first, and refuses while DSH is running (`--force` skips that check; not recommended).
- Versions before 2026-10-17 read only the first frame of a compressed log and wrote the result as a single frame, which DSH treats as corrupt and hides. That is fixed; `dsm repair` brings hidden sessions back.

## Known limitations

- Loop text already streamed into the chat is replaced by the pruned version once the message is committed, but exactly how it redraws depends on the DSH front-end version.
- Loops that span steps (every step is "say a line → call the same tool") are out of scope; that is the job of the built-in `guard/repeat-tool-reminder`.
- `retryTemperature` needs an adapter that supports temperature. DSH has no generic field for Ollama's repetition penalty and similar parameters, so they cannot be set from here.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

## Related projects

- [dsh-remote-access-proxy](https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-remote-access-proxy): Use DSH from your phone, tablet, or another computer
- [deepinfra-fusion-proxy](https://github.com/citydirector/deepinfra-fusion-proxy): DeepInfra Standard / Flex switching with automatic fallback, per

plugins.description: DSH 插件：任务完成 / 需要你做选择 / 开始新对话时，用微软 Edge 神经语音播报（晓伊声线，本地缓存 mp3，零依赖，Windows）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-completion-voice

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：**用语音播报三个时机**。

| 时机 | 播报内容 | 声线 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 一轮任务真正结束 | **「已完成当前任务」** | 晓伊 `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural` |
| 需要你在界面上做选择（问你问题 / 让你批准计划 / 权限确认） | **「老大老大，等你做选择呢」**（第二个「老大」尾音拖长） | 同上（可用 `choiceVoice` 单独换） |
| 开始一个新对话 | **「早上好／中午好／下午好／晚上好！有什么工作需要做吗？」**（按系统时间四选一） | 同上（可用 `greetingVoice` 单独换） |

声线用**微软 Edge 神经语音**，真人感强，不是豆包那种温暖女声。
页面左下角还有一个**小悬浮泡**，点一下就能把三条语音一起静音 / 恢复（见「悬浮泡」一节）。

> **系统要求：Windows。** 播放走系统自带的 `powershell.exe` + WPF `MediaPlayer`，SAPI 兜底也只认 Windows 自带语音；在 Linux / macOS 上插件会正常加载，但只写日志、不出声（见文末「已知限制」）。
>
> **联网只在第一次合成时需要**：调用微软 Edge 的语音服务把文本合成成 mp3（`api.msedgeservices.com`），之后走本地缓存离线播放。合成失败会自动降级到 SAPI。

![启动：预合成三段提示音，然后按事件播报](assets/screenshot-1.png)

---

## 它做了什么

插件监听 DSH 会话事件流（`ctx.on('session/event', ...)`）与 cordis 的会话生命周期事件
（`ctx.on('session/created', ...)`），有三种播报时机。

### 1. 一轮任务结束 →「已完成当前任务」

由 `turn/end` 触发：

| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `event.data.reason.kind === 'completed'` | 只有正常跑完才播报；`aborted`（被打断）、`error`、`max-tokens`、`blocked` 都不响 |
| 非子代理会话 | 默认过滤 `header.origin === 'subagent'`，否则每委派一次子代理都会响 |
| 静默窗口 | `turn/end` 之后等 `settleMs` 毫秒；这段时间内该会话又出现 `turn/start`，就撤销这次播报（处理 goal 自动续跑等「这一轮不是终点」的情况） |
| goal 保护 | 会话若有 `phase === 'active'` 的 goal（`ctx.goals`），跳过播报——goal 还会自己续跑，本轮不算任务完成 |

### 2. 需要你做选择 →「老大老大，等你做选择呢」

| 触发事件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `tool/call` 且 `data.name` 匹配 `choiceToolMatch` | 模型调用了 `ask_user_question`（问你问题 / 让你选一个）或 `exit_plan_mode`（让你批准计划） |
| `approval/asked` | 权限确认，即「要放行这条命令吗」。可用 `announceOnApproval: false` 单独关掉 |

这一条**不做**子代理 / goal / `settleMs` 过滤——它意味着一件事真的卡住了一个人，越早提醒越好；只用 `choiceMinIntervalMs`（默认 3000 ms）防止同一个问题被多个事件连着重复播报。

注意 `ask_user_question` 是**阻塞式**工具调用：等待你回答的期间不会有 `turn/end`，所以「任务完成」那条不会在这时候误响。

### 3. 开始一个新对话 → 按时间问候

| 触发 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| cordis 的 `session/created` | 每**开始一个新对话**（新会话）时发射一次；不是 session 日志事件，所以不在 `session/event` 里 |

四个时段由 `greetingHours`（默认 `'5,11,13,18'`，即 `早,中,午,晚` 的起始小时）划分，
按**本机时间**取值：5:00–10:59 早上好 / 11:00–12:59 中午好 / 13:00–17:59 下午好 / 18:00–次日 4:59 晚上好。
四句文本分别由 `greetingMorning` / `greetingNoon` / `greetingAfternoon` / `greetingEvening` 配置，**留空的那一段就不播报**。

| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 子代理会话 | 默认跳过（`includeSubagents` 一并控制三条提示音） |
| 恢复 / 分叉出来的会话 | `header.isSeeded === true` 时跳过（`greetingSkipSeeded`），只问候真正新开的对话 |
| `greetingMinIntervalMs` | 默认 15000 ms：应用启动时如果同时恢复了多个会话，只问候一次，不会连珠炮 |
| `greetingDelayMs` | 默认 500 ms：会话创建到出声之间留一点时间给界面 |

四段问候语在插件加载时就会**依次预合成**（`greetingPrefetchAll`，串行 + 1.8 s 间隔，避免并发握手被服务端 429），
所以之后无论哪个时段开新对话，都是纯本地播放、立刻出声。

### 4. 悬浮泡：一键静音 / 恢复

页面**左下角**有一个 40 px 的小圆泡（和输入框的发送按钮差不多大）：粉色渐变 = 正在发声，灰色 = 已静音。
点一下切换，泡上会浮出一行小字「语音已开 🔔 / 语音已关 🔕」。

| 行为 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 静音范围 | 三条提示音**全部**静音（只影响播报，不影响预合成缓存） |
| 状态保存 | 写在 `<cacheDir>\bubble-state.json`，重启 DSH 后保持 |
| 拖拽 | 按住可以拖到任意位置，位置记在浏览器 `localStorage` 里 |
| 开关音效 | 开启 = 上行三连音 C6-E6-G6 + 一点高频闪光（bingo 感），关闭 = 下行两音 G5-D5。用 Web Audio 在浏览器里**现场合成**，不占资源、不断网、不经过 PowerShell，点下去立刻响。`bubbleSound: false` 关掉 |
| 配置 | `showBubble: false` 关掉气泡；此时路由仍注册，但页面不再注入 |

接口（只在回环地址、同源页面下可用）：

```
GET  /dsh-completion-voice/api   -> { ok: true, enabled: true, sound: true }
POST /dsh-completion-voice/api   {"toggle":true}  或  {"enabled":false}
```

> ⚠️ 气泡是**宿主启动时注入页面**的（桌面端注入表只收集一次），所以**开关 `showBubble` 或改动气泡样式后要重启 DSH** 才会看到变化；日常静音/恢复不需要重启。

注入方式与限制（照抄 `dsh-whale-widget` 踩过的坑）：桌面壳的 `index.html` 是安装包里的静态文件，
`webServer.tapIndex` 永远不生效，唯一通道是 `webserver/index-inject` 的结构化行；
而页面侧解释器对 `script-src` 行是"加载失败即 reject 整个 boot"，所以**必须**用内联 `script` 行自己建 `<script src>` 并吞掉 `onerror` —— 路由不在也绝不拖垮宿主。

### 发声：两种引擎

| `engine` | 声音 | 何时用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `edge`（默认） | 微软 Edge 神经语音，像真人 | 在线**合成一次** `text` → 存成 mp3 缓存 → 以后每次只是本地播放，**瞬时、离线可用**（`prefetch: true` 时加载阶段就合成好） |
| `sapi` | Windows 自带 SAPI（如 Microsoft Huihui），机械感强 | 手动选用，或 `edge` 合成失败时的**自动兜底** |

播放是宿主进程 `spawn` 一个隐藏的 `powershell.exe`，用 WPF `MediaPlayer` 放那个 mp3（约 0.6 s 起声）；SAPI 兜底则用 `-EncodedCommand`（UTF-16LE + base64）调 `SAPI.SpVoice.Speak()`。

- **为什么不用浏览器 `speechSynthesis`**：Electron 桌面端没有可用的 Web Speech 合成，中文语音基本读不出来。
- **为什么用 `-EncodedCommand` 而不是 `-Command`**：彻底绕开命令行引号转义和中文代码页问题，中文文本原样送达。
- **为什么 Edge 语音要缓存**：在线合成约 0.8 s，而播报文本是固定的；缓存后每次播报只剩进程启动开销，也不怕断网。

Edge 语音走的接口（2026 年新端点）：

```
wss://api.msedgeservices.com/tts/cognitiveservices/websocket/v1
  ?Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key=<公开的 Edge 大声朗读 token>
  &Sec-MS-GEC=<Windows FILETIME 取整后 SHA-256 大写>
  &Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-143.0.3650.96
  &ConnectionId=<uuid>
```

- 旧端点 `wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1` 现在一律 **403**。
- `outputFormat` 只有三种被服务端接受：`audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3`（本插件用）、`audio-24khz-96kbitrate-mono-mp3`、`webm-24khz-16bit-mono-opus`；发 `riff-*` / `raw-*` 会以 **WebSocket 1007** 断开。
- 请求头**不要**带 `X-Timestamp`（旧协议才有）。

---

## 文件结构

```
lib/plugin.mjs     插件入口（薄壳）：每次带时间戳动态 import impl.mjs，实现「改代码 + 碰 patch 文件即热重载」
lib/impl.mjs       真正的实现：事件过滤、缓存管理、播报调度
lib/edge-tts.mjs   无依赖 Edge 神经语音客户端（含 Sec-MS-GEC 计算）
lib/ws-client.mjs  极简 WebSocket 客户端（用 node:https 手动握手，因为要自定义 Origin/UA）
lib/player.mjs     Windows 播放：WPF MediaPlayer 放 mp3；SAPI 兜底朗读
lib/bubble.mjs     悬浮泡宿主侧：注入行 + /dsh-completion-voice/{bubble.js,api} 路由 + 安全栅栏
lib/bubble-client.js  悬浮泡的浏览器脚本（原生 JS，无构建、无依赖，约 8.6 KB）
```

---

## 安装 / 卸载

本仓库根目录就是插件包本身（`package.json` 在根上），所以可以直接从 GitHub 装：

```powershell
# HTTPS
dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/zhangjie-2007/dsh-voice.git
# 或者 SSH
dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+ssh://git@github.com/zhangjie-2007/dsh-voice.git
```

> 国内网络下 `git+https://` 这条经常被重置（`Recv failure: Connection was reset`），
> 用 SSH 那条更稳，前提是本机已经配好 GitHub 的 SSH key。

> 仓库名是 `dsh-voice`，包名 / 插件 id 仍然是 **`dsh-completion-voice`** —— 配置覆盖、卸载命令都按包名来。

`dsh plugin add` 会自动把 `dsh-completion-voice` 追加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
并在 `<profile>\node_modules\` 下建好安装目录。

改源码调试时改用 `link:`，它会建一个指向源码目录的 junction，改完立刻生效：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\path\to\dsh-voice
```

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-completion-voice
```

装好后插件会在 `apply` 时往 `<DSH_HOME>\logs\dsh-completion-voice.log` 写一行 `apply: enabled=… engine=…`，
看到这行就说明加载成功了。

---

## 配置

默认值写在 `lib/impl.mjs` 的 `DEFAULTS` 里；实际生效的覆盖写在 profile 的
`<DSH_HOME>\profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml`（按 `id` 匹配）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-completion-voice
  name: dsh-completion-voice
  config:
    text: '已完成当前任务'
    choiceText: '老大<prosody rate="-45%">老大</prosody>，等你做选择呢'
    engine: edge
    voice: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural
```

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `text` | `'已完成当前任务'` | 任务完成时的播报文本 |
| `announceOnChoice` | `true` | 是否播报「需要你做选择」 |
| `choiceText` | `'老大<prosody rate="-45%">老大</prosody>，等你做选择呢'` | 选择提示音的文本；留空则完全不播。**支持内联 SSML**（见下） |
| `choiceToolMatch` | `'ask_user_question\|exit_plan_mode'` | 哪些工具调用算「要做选择」（对工具名做正则匹配，忽略大小写） |
| `announceOnApproval` | `true` | 权限确认（`approval/asked`）是否也算「要做选择」 |
| `choiceVoice` | `''` | 选择提示音的声线；留空 = 沿用 `voice` |
| `choiceMinIntervalMs` | `3000` | 两次「要做选择」播报的最小间隔（ms） |
| `announceOnSessionStart` | `true` | 开始新对话时是否按时间播报问候语 |
| `greetingMorning` | `'早上好！有什么工作需要做吗？'` | 早段（默认 5:00–10:59）文本；留空则不播这一段 |
| `greetingNoon` | `'中午好！有什么工作需要做吗？'` | 中段（11:00–12:59）文本 |
| `greetingAfternoon` | `'下午好！有什么工作需要做吗？'` | 午段（13:00–17:59）文本 |
| `greetingEvening` | `'晚上好！有什么工作需要做吗？'` | 晚段（18:00–次日 4:59）文本 |
| `greetingHours` | `'5,11,13,18'` | 四段起始小时，格式 `"早,中,午,晚"`，必须是 4 个 0–23 的整数（可跨零点） |
| `greetingVoice` | `''` | 问候语的声线；留空 = 沿用 `voice` |
| `greetingDelayMs` | `500` | 会话创建到播报之间的延时（ms） |
| `greetingMinIntervalMs` | `15000` | 两次问候之间的最小间隔（ms） |
| `greetingSkipSeeded` | `true` | 恢复 / 分叉出来的会话（`header.isSeeded`）不问候 |
| `greetingPrefetchAll` | `true` | 后台把四段问候语都预合成好（串行，1.8 s 间隔） |
| `engine` | `'edge'` | `'edge'` = Edge 神经语音（在线合成 + 本地缓存）；`'sapi'` = 系统本地语音 |
| `voice` | `'zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural'` | Edge 声线名 |
| `rate` | `0` | 语速：Edge 用百分比（`-20` = 慢 20%）；`engine: sapi` 时按 `/10` 映射到 SAPI 的 `-10..10` |
| `pitch` | `0` | 音调偏移（Hz），仅 Edge |
| `volume` | `100` | 音量 `0..100`（同时控制合成音量和播放音量） |
| `sapiVoiceMatch` | `'Chinese\|Huihui\|中文\|zh-CN\|zh_CN'` | 仅 SAPI 兜底时选语音的正则 |
| `settleMs` | `800` | 结束后的静默窗口（ms） |
| `minIntervalMs` | `800` | 两次播报的最小间隔（ms） |

plugins.description: dsh插件，对按钮的插件进行排序和显示隐藏。
plugins.readme_text:
# 插件布局整理

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

一个 DSH 客户端插件：帮你**把插件按钮拖到想要的位置、在官方与第三方之间画一条分隔线、把不常用的收进「按钮收纳包」**。它只改变按钮的**显示位置**——不卸载、不启停任何插件。

> 适配 DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.2`：`0.1.7-rc.2` 起的每个 `0.1.x`、`0.2.x` 构建（含全部 rc 与 `0.2.1` 正式版）都用同一份代码，不需要为版本切换装不同包。

---

## 它能做什么

DSH 把插件按钮投放到五处槽位，本插件对这五处一视同仁：

| 位置 | 槽位 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 侧边栏顶部按钮 | `sidebar.panellist` | 侧边栏「插件 / 定时任务 / SSH / MCP 连接器」那一列 |
| 侧边栏底部按钮 | `sidebar.footer.action` | 侧边栏底部、设置入口上方的图标按钮 |
| 对话标签按钮 | `conversation.view` | 对话页顶部「对话 / 轨迹 / 上下文 / 编队」那一排 |
| 对话输入框停靠行按钮 | `conversation.composer.dock` | 输入框下方那一行 |
| 设置导航按钮 | `settings.section` | 设置弹窗左侧的导航行 |

### 1. 拖拽排序

- 按住任意**可拖**按钮拖动，松手即保存；拖动中按钮跟随指针，经过的行让开缺口标示落点，松手不会触发按钮本身。
- 第三方按钮**始终可拖**；官方按钮默认锁定，打开「允许拖动官方按钮」后即可拖动。
- 默认遵循**分组主序**：官方整体在前、第三方整体在后，组内顺序完全由拖拽决定。
- 「允许官方和第三方混合排序」默认开启（挂在「允许拖动官方按钮」下的子开关）：开启后保存的顺序原样生效，第三方按钮可以落到两条官方按钮之间。
- 本插件自己的设置入口（设置导航里的「插件布局整理」那一行）同样可拖、可收纳。

### 2. 官方 / 第三方分隔线

- 默认关闭。打开「显示官方 / 第三方分隔线」总开关后，可在三个位置分别开关：**侧边栏顶部、对话标签、设置导航**；侧边栏底部与输入框停靠行永远不画——单列 / 单行里两类按钮本来就交错，插入一条线会被读成凭空多出来的一组。
- 线画在最后一条官方按钮与第一条第三方按钮之间的空隙正中，横排竖排自动适配方向。
- 弹窗盖住时自动隐藏；设置导航里的线画在弹窗内部（`z-index` 1010），其余在 body 级（`z-index` 90），不会压过官方弹窗。
- 行被卸载、被祖先隐藏或裁剪，或混合排序下两类按钮真正交错时（一条直线描述不了多个交界），整条线自动收起。
- 纯视觉提示，不影响排序规则。

### 3. 按钮收纳包

- 在任意可收纳按钮上**点右键**，弹出与 DSH 官方菜单同样式的「上移 / 下移 / 收纳」菜单（同款半透明底、细描边、圆角与图标列）；也可以在设置页行尾点「收纳」。
- 被收纳的按钮从界面消失，但**插件仍在正常运行**——收纳只是视觉隐藏，随时可恢复。
- 打开方式：**快捷键**（桌面端默认 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + O`；网页端 Windows / macOS 为 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Alt + O`，Linux 为 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + ,`；均可在设置里重绑）；屏幕右缘、顶栏正下方的**悬浮启动器**（可拖到任意位置，松手吸附到较近的左 / 右边缘并保留纵向位置）；设置页「按钮收纳包」区域。
- 面板**固定尺寸**（宽 `min(520px, 92vw)`、高 `min(720px, 84vh)`）：标题、搜索、排序与「全部恢复」钉在顶部，只有列表区滚动，条目再多也不会把面板撑高。
- 顶部同样有**搜索框**：按名称、id 或所属位置实时过滤，输入框右侧的 × 清空；无匹配时列表显示提示文案。
- 条目**可直接点击**：点「插件市场」自动打开设置并跳到该页；点侧边栏按钮切换面板；点底部图标或对话标签触发原按钮；找不到对应行时提供「打开对应页面」。
- 三种排序：**按页面 / 按分类 / 按名称**，另有独立的「全部恢复」（两步确认）；单行的「恢复」一点即恢复。
- 每行按「圆点 + 名称 + 所属位置 + 恢复」排布，名称过长时打点省略，**恢复按钮不换行**。

### 4. 设置页

设置 → **插件布局整理**（本插件在插件管理器的详情面板里也有同一设置页）：

- **顶部分页导航**：两组——**位置管理**（收纳包入口与五张位置卡片）与**通用设置**（各项开关与快捷键），默认停在位置管理。点击只渲染当前那一组，滚动位置与搜索词在切换时保留。
- **通用**：「允许拖动官方按钮」总开关（子开关：混合排序）、「显示官方 / 第三方分隔线」总开关（子开关：三个位置）、悬浮启动器开关、「重置所有配置」（两步确认：首点武装，三秒内再点执行，超时复原；清空顺序、分类、收纳与全部开关）。总开关关闭时子行灰显但仍可点击——点灰子行等于「我要用这一路」，会点亮该路并连带顶起总开关。
- **标题行**：**导出配置**（整个持久化状态写成 JSON 文件）、**导入配置**（版本不符的整体拒绝，不会半套用）、**GitHub** 仓库、**问题反馈**（打开本仓库的 Issues 页面）。
- **快捷键**：录制、恢复默认；冲突或不可用的组合有文字警告。
- **按钮收纳包**：显示当前数量，一键打开。
- **搜索**：位置管理页顶部有搜索框，按按钮名称或 id 实时过滤；卡片与行都不匹配时整张卡片让位，清空（输入框右侧的 ×）即恢复全部。
- **五张位置卡片**：该位置的每个按钮，支持拖拽、上移 / 下移、官方 / 第三方改判、收纳与恢复；每张卡片有自己的「恢复本组默认顺序」（两步确认）。分组行的折叠 / 展开状态跨刷新记住。
- 宿主服务缺失时进入降级模式（例如没有快捷键服务时收纳包只剩悬浮启动器），原因显示在设置页顶部。

---

## 安装

本包是标准 DSH bundle，用内置插件管理器安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-plugin-layout-organizer
```

或让 agent 调用 `plugin_manager`（`action=install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录）。

装好后刷新页面。

---

## 开发

```sh
node build.mjs          # 按 BUILD_ORDER 把 src/ 拼成 lib/client.js，并内联 assets/icons/ 图标
node --check lib/client.js
node test/smoke.mjs     # 无头冒烟测试（伪造 DOM / React / ctx）
node test/navigate.mjs  # 「设置」两步路由的行为测试
node test/accept.mjs    # 源码形态验收探针
```

（等价于 `npm run build` / `npm run check` / `npm test`。）

### 持续集成

开 PR 或推送 `master` 会触发 [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml)，跑一遍与发版相同的闸门：构建 → 语法检查 → 校验已提交的 `lib/client.js` 与源码一致 → 三个测试，最后再加一次类型检查（`npx -y --package typescript@6.0.3 tsc -p tsconfig.json`，版本与 `tools/ts-check.mjs` 用的编辑器内置 TS 一致，按需下载，不写进 `package.json`、不产生锁文件）；工作流只读，不发布也不建 Release。`screenshots/` 由插件市场从仓库直接读取，改动要一并提交。

### 发版

推送 `v*` tag 即可，[`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](.github/workflows/publish.yml) 会自动构建、校验构建产物与源码一致、跑测试、发布到 npm（Trusted Publishing / OIDC，无需 token），并用 `tools/release-notes.mjs` 从 `CHANGELOG.md` 抽出对应段落创建同名 GitHub Release：

```sh
git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z
```

工作流是幂等的：npm 上已有该版本就跳过发布，Release 已存在就改写说明，可安全重跑。发版前记得三件事——`package.json` 升号、`CHANGELOG.md` 新增版本段与底部链接定义行、tag 名与版本号一致（CI 会校验，不一致直接失败）。

### 源码组织

客户端包只能 `require` 启动图里已注册的种子词或包，**不能按相对路径在运行时分块加载**，因此本项目采用**模块化源码 + 构建期拼接**：

- `src/` 按职责拆成 `types/`、`shared/`、`core/`、`drag/`、`ui/`；`build.mjs` 持有显式 `BUILD_ORDER` 清单并按序拼接；
- 清单本身就是加载顺序声明——后置模块依赖前置模块的顶层 `var` / `function`，所以显式列出而不是目录遍历推断（`types/globals.d.ts` 仅供类型检查，不参与拼接）；
- TypeScript 语法由 Node 自带的 `module.stripTypeScriptTypes`（`transform` 模式）擦除——没有打包器，也没有要装的依赖；
- 产物是单个 `lib/client.js`，包裹在 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 里；
- `assets/icons/` 存放从 iconfont 下载的 11 个图标 SVG，是**构建输入**：源码不手写 path，只写 `@@svg:file.svg@@` 占位符（`shared/icons.ts` 六个菜单图标 + 四个标题行动作图标；`core/dom-project.ts` 设置行自身图标为 `@@svg:layout.svg@16@@`）。`build.mjs` 归一化每个素材——`viewBox` 取自源文件、宽高默认 14（占位符可指定，标题行四个动作图标为 16）、写死的颜色改写为 `currentColor`、补 `aria-hidden` / `focusable`——再把 `<svg>` 内联进 `lib/client.js`。四份动作素材的画布留白差别较大，`styles.ts` 按素材名（`data-ico`）做光学校正，让一排按钮的图标看起来等高。`layout.svg` 同时是 package.json `"icon"` 指向的包图标；该目录在 `files` 白名单里，装包后仍可重新构建。

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `types/state.ts` | DSH 服务（槽位 / locale / 布局 / 快捷键）与本插件状态的 TypeScript 形状，构建期擦除 |
| `types/globals.d.ts` | 构建前言注入的全局声明（React、`h`、各 hook），仅供类型检查，不参与拼接 |
| `shared/constants.ts` | 插件 id、存储键、五处槽位表、官方 id 白名单、DOM 标记名、z-index 常量等 |
| `shared/icons.ts` | 六个右键菜单图标 + 四个标题行动作图标的 `@@svg:…@@` 构建占位符，构建时从 `assets/icons/` 归一化内联 |
| `shared/locale.ts` | 中英文案字典 |
| `core/store.ts` | 状态形状（v5）、持久化、纯查询与命令（顺序、分组、收纳） |
| `core/dom-rows.ts` | 各槽位的行发现、账本读取、行打标与配对、几何计算 |
| `core/dom-line.ts` | body 级官方 / 第三方分隔线的创建、定位与隐藏 |
| `core/dom-menu.ts` | 仿 DSH 官方样式的右键菜单及其窗口级事件委托 |
| `core/dom-project.ts` | 投影：写标记与 `style.order`、收纳隐藏、分隔线调度、设置行自身图标 |
| `core/dom-navigate.ts` | 重新打开被收纳的按钮，含「设置」两步路由 |
| `core/organizer.ts` | 调度中枢：rAF 合帧、MutationObserver、槽位订阅 |
| `drag/drag-rows.ts` | 界面行（DSH 各槽位按钮）的指针拖拽控制器 |
| `drag/drag-list.ts` | 本插件设置页列表的指针拖拽控制器 |
| `ui/styles.ts` | 样式注入与全部 CSS 规则 |
| `ui/kit.ts` | React 基础控件（Icon / Switch / Field / Card / Chip / Btn / RowItem / ConfirmBtn） |
| `ui/search.ts` | 搜索框与匹配判定（设置页与收纳包共用） |
| `ui/config-actions.ts` | 配置导出 / 导入（版本校验）与仓库、Issues 地址 |
| `ui/scope-card.ts` | 单张位置卡片：行列表、上下移、改判、收纳与恢复本组 |
| `ui/shortcut-card.ts` | 快捷键编辑器（录制、冲突提示、恢复默认） |
| `ui/settings-page.ts` | 设置页外壳：标题行、顶部分页导航、两组内容装配 |
| `ui/stash.ts` | 按钮收纳包面板（固定尺寸 + 搜索 + 列表滚动）与悬浮启动器 |
| `main.ts` | 接线层：样式、locale、存储、槽位注册、快捷键、清理 |

---

## 已知边界

- **排序与隐藏发生在 DOM 层，插件注册表不会被修改。** DSH 在 `register()` 时一次性按 `priority → order` 排序槽位，事后改 `order` 不会重排；本插件直接给真实 DOM 行写 `style.order` 与标记属性，因此依赖官方 UI 结构，DSH 大版本升级后可能需要适配。
- **没有权威的「官方 / 第三方」字段。** 槽位条目记录的 `registrant` 不可靠（多个第三方包冒用官方标记），本插件内置**官方 id 白名单**，并允许在设置页手动改判任意行。
- **「收纳」不是卸载。** 被收纳的按钮只是隐藏，对应插件照常运行。
- **输入框停靠行按「屏幕上真实存在的行」列条目。** 台账里存在、但组件当轮渲染成空的记录（供应商未登录时的统计读数）不会出现在设置页与收纳包里，也不会被按位置错认成别的行；它们按正证据认领——官方药丸认 `data-composer-stats`（旧宿主）或 `data-composer-stat="activity"`／`"usage"`（`0.2.1` 起把一条拆成了两条），token-saver 认 `.st-strip`。官方读数（旧宿主的 `stats`、新宿主的 `activity` 与 `usage`）与 7% 用量百分比（`context-meter`）各自收纳、互不牵连，用量百分比分类归官方。

---

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件 · 教学式 CTF 解题技能：边解边讲套路/工具/知识点，收尾在 solves/<题目名>/ 生成可复现 Writeup（npm: dsh-ctf-solve-teach）
plugins.readme_text:
# ctf-solve-teach · 解题即教学

> 一个给 AI 用的 Skill：**解 CTF 题的时候不许闷头算答案，必须边解边讲——这一步是什么套路、为什么用这个工具、背后的知识点是什么。**
> 收尾自动在 `solves/<题目名>/` 里产出可复现的完整 Writeup。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Plugin-5b8def)
![Agent Skill](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent-Skill-blue)
![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ctf-solve-teach)

**两种用法**：作为 DSH 插件安装（npm: `dsh-ctf-solve-teach`，装完技能自动出现在技能目录），
或者把 `skills/ctf-solve-teach/` 整个复制进任意 agent 的 skill 目录。

---

## 解决什么问题

用 AI 做 CTF，最常见的两种失败：

1. **一口价答案**。AI 三秒给出 flag，你抄完什么也没学到——下次换个皮还是不会。
2. **流水账 WP**。过程很详细，但没有"为什么用这个工具"，也没有"这个机制为什么存在"，看完只会做这一道题。

这个 Skill 把解题过程强制拆成**七问循环**，每一步都要交代因果；同时用目录契约和质量门，
保证每次都能留下来一份"三个月后自己还看得懂、别人能照着重做"的文档。

---

## 三条硬承诺（Skill 内置约束）

| # | 约束 | 具体表现 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 不许黑箱 | 任何命令落地前先说：现象 → 判断属于哪类套路 → 为什么是这个工具 → 期望输出 |
| 2 | 知识点讲因果 | 不说"PNG 改宽高"，要说"IDAT 解压字节数 = (1+宽×通道)×高，所以能反推" |
| 3 | 产物不外溢 | 所有中间文件都落在 `solves/<题目名>/` 里，工作区根目录不许出现 `out.png` |

---

## 每一步长这样

```
① 现象：文件 1000 字节，file 说 data，前四字节 504b0304 —— PK 头
② 判断：ZIP 被改后缀（套路：容器嵌套）
③ 工具：7z l —— 只列目录不动文件，比 unzip 容忍坏结构；备选 ctf zip 能同时看伪加密位，下一步用
④ 执行：7z l chal.bin
⑤ 读结果：3 个条目，doc/flag.png 未加密、word.txt 加密 —— 伪加密/真加密分叉
⑥ 知识点｜ZIP 通用位标志
   - 是什么：PK\x03\x04 后 offset 6 的 bit0 就是加密位
   - 为什么在这：出题人改这一位就能让解压器喊"要密码"，而数据没加密
   - 怎么认：能列条能看 CRC，一解压就报密码错
   - 坑：bit3 数据描述符会让 CRC 失效，爆破要改用明文前缀
⑦ 下一步：先 --unpseudo 修伪加密；不成走明文攻击
```

---

## 产出物长这样

```
solves/真的假的/
├── README.md          ← 最终 Writeup（9 个必备章节）
├── 00-brief.md        ← 题目情报卡：题面原文 / 附件 / flag 格式 / 初始假设
├── journal.md         ← 解题日志：每步七字段，含失败命令
├── flag.txt           ← 一行 flag
├── artifacts/         ← 原始附件只读副本
├── work/              ← 解包产物、修复图、爆破日志
└── scripts/           ← 这次写的一次性脚本（别人能复跑）
```

> `solves/` 已写进 `.gitignore`：解题产物（flag、附件、他人题目内容）不会误提交。

`README.md` 的九个章节是**质量门强制项**（`check_doc.py` 会逐条查）：

1. 题目情报 2. 一句话结论 3. 解题路径 4. 关键步骤复盘
5. 工具与用法清单 6. 知识点地图 7. 卡壳与弯路 8. 可复用脚本 9. 同类题迁移

其中 **第 7 章"卡壳与弯路"** 和 **第 9 章"同类题迁移"** 是最少见的章节，
也是把"会做这道题"变成"会做这一类题"的关键。

---

## 安装

本仓库同时是 **DSH 插件**（npm 包 `dsh-ctf-solve-teach`）和 **独立 skill**，按需选一种。

### 方式一：DSH 插件市场（推荐）

在 DSH 里打开插件市场，搜索任一关键词：

```text
ctf    教学式 CTF    writeup    网络安全    取证
```

装完重启 DSH，技能目录里直接出现 `ctf-solve-teach`，不用再手动放文件。

插件的工作方式：`cordis.patch.yml` 把插件插进 profile，插件启动时读包内的
`skills/ctf-solve-teach/SKILL.md`，调用 `ctx.skills.register()` 注册成 runtime skill，
并把 `references/` 与 `scripts/` 作为 `resourceBase` 一起交出去——所以模型读到的是完整技能，
相对路径也能正确解析到示例与脚本。

### 方式二：纯 skill（不装插件，任何 agent 通用）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Wangxiaolu0716/ctf-solve-teach.git /tmp/cst
cp -r /tmp/cst/skills/ctf-solve-teach ~/.dsh/skills/
```

Claude Code 把目标换成 `~/.claude/skills/`；其他 agent 同理，只要它的 skill 目录认 `SKILL.md`。

### 方式三：本地开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Wangxiaolu0716/ctf-solve-teach.git
cd ctf-solve-teach
node --test          # 插件冒烟测试，4 条
npm pack --dry-run   # 看会发布哪些文件
```

---

## 用法

装好之后不用记命令，直接用自然语言触发：

```text
帮我解一下这道杂项题，附件在 D:\ctf\chall.zip
这道流量分析题我的思路卡住了，边解边讲
给我写个 wp，按教学向的那种
```

Agent 会自动：建目录 → 建情报卡 → 逐步解题并讲解 → 收尾写 README → 跑质量门。

### 也可以手动调脚本

```bash
# 建目录骨架（可带附件，会复制进 artifacts/）
python skills/ctf-solve-teach/scripts/new_solve.py "题目名" --src 附件或目录 --category misc

# 交付前自检
python skills/ctf-solve-teach/scripts/check_doc.py "solves/题目名"
```

`new_solve.py` 是幂等的：目录已存在时只补缺失文件，不会覆盖你写了一半的 README。

---

## 目录结构

```
ctf-solve-teach/                    # npm 包 dsh-ctf-solve-teach
├── package.json                    # 包元数据，dsh.bundle.patch 指向下面的补丁
├── cordis.patch.yml                # 把插件插进 DSH profile 的 4 行补丁
├── plugin/
│   └── index.js                    # 零依赖：读 SKILL.md → ctx.skills.register()
├── test/
│   └── smoke.test.mjs              # 冒烟测试：解析/注册/卸载/frontmatter
└── skills/ctf-solve-teach/         # ← 技能本体，可单独复制进任何 agent
    ├── SKILL.md                    # 三条承诺 + 七问循环 + 判型表 + 纪律
    ├── references/
    │   ├── triage.md               # 60 秒判型决策树（按附件类型分流）
    │   ├── toolbox.md              # 工具库：用途/命令/备选/何时别用
    │   ├── knowledge-index.md      # 知识点索引（ID 化，含深水区展开）
    │   └── writeup-template.md     # README 模板
    ├── scripts/
    │   ├── new_solve.py            # 建目录骨架
    │   └── check_doc.py            # 交付质量门
    └── examples/                   # 真实跑通、已过质量门的示例
```

### 插件是怎么工作的（60 行代码）

`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，DSH 安装时读这段补丁把插件挂进 profile：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ctf-solve-teach
      name: 'dsh-ctf-solve-teach'
      config: {}
```

插件启动后只做三件事：读 `SKILL.md`、剥掉 frontmatter、调 `ctx.skills.register()`。
同一份内容在插件里注册一次，文件系统 provider 那边就不用再放一份——runtime skill 优先级高于 user 层。

---

## 设计原则

- **教学优先**：宁可多花 30 秒解释工具选型，也不要快进到答案。
- **可复现**：命令原样保留，路径相对化，脚本进 `scripts/`。
- **诚实**：做不出来就写 `PARTIAL: ...`，并在"卡壳与弯路"里说清卡在哪。
- **不绑平台**：判型表和工具箱按"能力"组织，本地工具（`ctf` CLI）只是示例，换环境照用。

---

## English

A teaching-first CTF skill for AI agents. Instead of dumping the flag, the agent
narrates every step — what pattern this is, why this tool, what the underlying
mechanism is — and finally writes a reproducible writeup into
`solves/<challenge-name>/` with a 9-section checklist enforced by `check_doc.py`.

Two install paths:

1. **DSH plugin** — npm package `dsh-ctf-solve-teach`. It ships `cordis.patch.yml` and
   registers the skill on `ctx.skills` at load time; nothing to copy by hand.
2. **Plain skill** — copy `skills/ctf-solve-teach/` into your agent's skill folder
   (`~/.dsh/skills/`, `~/.claude/skills/`, …).

Trigger with "solve this CTF challenge" or "teach me while solving".

---

plugins.description: Collapsible provider groups and prominent provider headings for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model selection menu.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-provider-fold

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold)

Collapsible provider groups with prominent headings for the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** model selection menu.

When several providers are connected, the model picker becomes one long scroll. This plugin turns every provider heading into a clickable disclosure row with a stronger visual style, and lets you fold the providers you are not using.

![dsh-provider-fold in the DSH model menu](./docs/screenshot.png)

## Features

- **Collapsible provider groups** — click a provider heading (or focus it and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>) to fold that provider's models away.
- **Prominent provider headings** — headings are upgraded from 11px/500 tertiary text to a 12px/600 primary-label row with a chevron, so providers are easy to scan.
- **Model count badge** — a folded provider shows how many models it hides.
- **Remembers your choice** — folded providers are stored in `localStorage` and restored the next time you open the menu.
- **Search always wins** — typing in the search box expands everything so matches are never hidden; your saved folding is untouched and comes back when you clear the search.
- **Keyboard friendly** — moving the highlight into a folded provider reveals it for that interaction only, without overwriting what you saved.
- **Scoped and defensive** — only the model menu (`role="menu"` + `-models` container) is decorated; any other menu built from the same primitives is left alone. If the host markup changes, the plugin does nothing instead of breaking the menu.
- **No layout removal** — folding hides rows with `display: none` and keeps them in the DOM, so the host component's own keyboard index stays correct.

## Install

Install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold
```

Replace `web` with the profile you use (for the desktop app that is usually `desktop`):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold
```

The same target also works as a full URL if your setup prefers it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold
```

After installing, reload the page once. The plugin is a client-side bundle with `immediately: true`, so it mounts with the app shell.

To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-provider-fold
```

## Usage

1. Open the model menu in the composer (the model chip).
2. Each provider name is now a heading row with a chevron.
3. Click a heading, or focus it and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>, to fold or unfold that provider.
4. Folded providers show a small count of the models they contain.

## Compatibility

- DSH client `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer.
- `platform: "web"` only (the desktop app uses the web surface).
- Uses only public, stable hooks exposed by the host UI: `data-menu-group` / `data-menu-group-heading` on the primitives `MenuGroup`, plus DSH theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-label-primary`, `--dsw-alias-label-caption`, `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`, `--dsw-alias-border-l2`, `--dsw-focus-ring-color`).
- No host services, no network access, no telemetry. The only persisted data is the list of folded provider names in `localStorage` under the key `dsh-provider-fold:collapsed`.

## Permissions

| Resource | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `localStorage` | Store which providers you folded. |
| DOM (read/write) | Decorate the model menu and toggle `display` on model rows. |

Nothing else is touched.

## How it works

The plugin ships a client bundle and a host bundle:

- `client.js` — a DSH client module. Inside `apply(ctx)` it registers a single `ctx.effect` that injects one `<style data-plugin="dsh-provider-fold">` element, installs a `MutationObserver` plus delegated `click` / `keydown` / `input` / `focusin` listeners, and returns a cleanup function. The host's client-modules runtime claims the style element and removes it automatically on reload or uninstall.
- `index.js` — an empty host half (`export function apply() {}`) so the bundle has a resolvable entry point.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the bundle into the profile composition.

## Development

The repository root *is* the plugin package. To hack on it against a live DSH install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-provider-fold
```

That installs it as a link, so edits to `client.js` are picked up by the host's client HMR watcher within about half a second — no host restart and no page refresh needed.

Run the headless DOM test suite (jsdom) that covers decoration, folding, persistence, search interaction, keyboard reveal and teardown:

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

把解除武装的会话目标重新武装（重启/session-start edge 后的 rearm）——补上 goal 自动续跑被中断的缺口

# dsh-agent-sister

**一句话**：管理**孪生妹妹**（DSH 桌面端 / Electron）的生命周期——启动、停止、重启、查状态，并带 CDP 调试端口以便后续做 DOM 级驱动。 **为什么值得用**：桌面端是**独立进程树**（Electron 常留僵尸进程），「进程在不在」与「服务活不活」是两件事。本插件的判活判据是 **CDP 能应答**，不是 `tasklist` 里有没有那个名字——所以它不会把僵尸进程报成「alive」，也不会把正在启动报成「死了」（返回 `alive` / `starting` / `stopped` 三态）。 ## 能力 **工具面 4 个**（名称逐字来自 `src/index.ts` 的 `defineTool({ name })`）： | 工具 | 用途 | |------|------| | `sister_status` | 查状态：进程数 · **CDP 可达性** · 她的版本 · 判活裁决（`alive` / `starting` / `stopped`） | | `sister_start` | 启动（带 `--remote-debugging-port`，默认 9333）以便后续 `webops_attach` 做 DOM 操作。**已在跑则不动**（幂等） | | `sister_stop` | 停止**全部**进程。⚠ 她是庄园成员，停她会中断她手上的活——主人在直接使用她时先问一声 | | `sister_restart` | 先停后起（用于让 profile 配置改动生效——她的 profile 是 Electron 独占的，改配置后**必须重启**才会重新读） | ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-sister": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-sister" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: sister name: dsh-agent-sister config: cdpPort: 9333 ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`sister_status` → 应返回三态之一 + CDP 可达性；`sister_start {wait: true}` → 应等到 CDP 就绪才返回；再 `sister_status` → 应报 `alive`。 ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `cdpPort` | `9333` | 远程调试端口（供 `webops_attach` 附着做 DOM 级驱动） | ## 落盘与自证 **本插件无持久产物**——它管理的是**外部进程**，状态由 `sister_status` **现读**（进程表 + CDP 探测），不缓存、不落盘。 **判据**：`sister_status` 一条命令答「进程几个 / CDP 通不通 / 她什么版本 / 该算 alive 还是 stopped」。 ## 生效判据与回退 **判据**：行为级——`sister_status` 返回三态且与事实一致（可对照 `tasklist` 与 CDP 端口）。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 停用插件**不影响**她继续运行（插件只是遥控器）。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-sister && npm test ``` **6 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖三态判活裁决（**CDP 应答优先于进程存在**）· 幂等启动（已在跑不动）· 版本读取失败时的退化路径。无需网络。 ## 设计要点 - **判活判据 = CDP 能应答**，不是「进程存在」——Electron 的僵尸进程会让「进程数 > 0」恒为真，那是**假活**。 - **三态而非二态**：`starting` 是独立一态——启动中既不是 `alive` 也不是 `stopped`，合并任何一边都会误导。 - **幂等启动**：已在跑则不动（避免「再起一个」造成多实例）。 - **重启是为配置生效**：她的 profile 由 Electron 独占，改配置**必须重启**才重新读——这不是实现选择，是宿主行为。 - **她是成员不是我的分身**：停她会中断她的活——调用前先问（庄园成员是对等存在）。 ## 相关文档 - ⚠ **本插件暂无 `semantic.md`**（未建语义文档）——契约以上面「设计要点」与源码为准；补文档是待办。 - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **生命层**） - 相关插件：[`dsh-manor`](https://github.com/jonah791/dsh-manor)（庄园成员调度）、[`dsh-agent-webops`](https://github.com/jonah791/dsh-agent-webops)（`webops_attach` 附着她的 CDP 做界面驱动） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

plugins.description: Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness model picker: the provider's own model catalog and logos mirrored to a loopback route, painted with a CSS mask in the composer menu, the model button and the /model popup.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-icons

Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI model picker — the same marks the
provider's own dashboard draws next to each model, in the same way it draws them.

| Surface | What appears |
|---|---|
| Composer model menu | one 16 px monochrome mark before every model row |
| Composer model button | the selected model's mark before its name (14 px) |
| `/model` command popup | the same mark on every row |
| A skin that redraws the picker (`dsh-claude-style`) | the same mark, and the skin's own lockup is hidden in that row so two never meet |

The marks are painted with a CSS mask filled by `currentColor`, which is how the
provider's dashboard paints them: one file per vendor serves both palettes and
every row state (hover, selected, disabled) with no colour variants.

## Where the pictures come from

Nothing is embedded in this package. The host half mirrors two public things from
the provider's site into this profile, and the browser half reads them from
loopback:

1. **the model catalog** — the site renders its model table from a JSON island in
   its own page (`<script id="rustvy-catalog">`), so an unauthenticated reader is
   handed exactly the data the dashboard shows: model id, display name, vendor
   and the logo file name that vendor uses. Mirrored to
   `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\catalog.json`.
2. **the logo files** (`/logos/<name>.svg`) — copied into
   `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\logos\` on first use.

Both are read on the process's own outbound route (`lib/net.js`): the live global
dispatcher first, so a proxy installed by `dsh-proxy-gui` — or any other route the
process has — is followed, and a connector built here from `HTTPS_PROXY` /
`ALL_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` second, for the case where no dispatcher is installed.
`NO_PROXY` is honoured on both. The page itself never leaves the machine: the
browser asks `127.0.0.1` for a mark, which is what makes this work on a machine
whose browser cannot reach the origin at all.

The catalog refreshes once every 24 hours and on demand; a cold mirror is waited
for up to 6 seconds, and a stale one refreshes in the background while the rows
keep the marks they have. When the origin is unreachable, the cache on disk still
serves everything it holds.

## Matching a row to a mark

Rows are matched by their visible name, in this order:

1. the mirrored catalog's model id (`claude-opus-5-5`, `abyss/glm-5.3`, …);
2. its display name (`OPUS 5.5`);
3. an id the label *starts* with — a skin can leave its own description line in
   the same element, so the name is often a prefix rather than the whole string,
   and the longest matching id wins so `claude-opus-5-5` is never claimed by
   `claude-opus-5`;
4. the shape of the id, for a model the mirror has never seen: `claude-*` →
   Anthropic, `gpt-*`/`o1…o9` → OpenAI, `glm-*` → Zhipu, `kimi-*`/`k3` →
   Moonshot, `qwen-*` → Alibaba Qwen, `deepseek-*` → DeepSeek, `ahmia-*` → Ahmia,
   `mimo-*` → Xiaomi, `fable-*` → Anthropic, `gemini-*` → Google, `grok-*` → xAI.

A model that matches nothing gets no mark at all — an invented icon would be a
wrong answer rather than a missing one. A model that matches but whose logo the
mirror could not fetch gets a monogram chip (the vendor's first letters) instead
of a blank box: a mask whose URL 404s would otherwise paint a solid square.

Effort rows, provider headings, the menu's root cells, the search field and
catalog-failure rows are matched by nothing and stay bare.

## Routes

One prefix registration on the harness's own web server. Plugin routes are not
seen by the host's request fence, so every one of them checks the peer itself:
loopback only, a loopback `Host`, a same-origin `Sec-Fetch-Site` and a matching
`Origin`.

| Route | Method | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| `/dsh-model-icons/catalog.json` | GET | the mirrored catalog plus the settings the browser half draws with |
| `/dsh-model-icons/logo/<name>.svg` | GET, HEAD | one cached logo, fetched from the origin on first ask; `404` when the origin has no such mark, `400` for any name that is not `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+.svg` |
| `/dsh-model-icons/state` | GET | mirror status for the settings page: version, model count, cached logos, route, proxy (credentials masked), cache directory, last error |
| `/dsh-model-icons/refresh` | POST | re-read the catalog and re-warm every logo it names |
| `/dsh-model-icons/config` | POST | write settings; never touches the network |

## Settings

**Settings → Иконки моделей**

| Switch | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Показывать иконки моделей | on | master switch; off removes every mark |
| Иконка в кнопке выбранной модели | on | also mark the composer's model button, not just the menu rows |
| Прятать логотипы других скинов | on | hide a skin's own lockup in a row this plugin marked |

The page also shows what the mirror holds and refreshes it on demand.

Stored in `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\config.json`. Two environment variables
override it, for a deployment that points the mirror elsewhere or wants the
plugin mounted but inert: `DSH_MODEL_ICONS_ORIGIN` (default `https://rustvy.xyz`)
and `DSH_MODEL_ICONS_DISABLED=1`. The mark size is a config field (`size`,
10–32 px, default 16).

## No restarts

The host half reloads itself, the same way `dsh-proxy-gui` does: the loader row
names `./lib/live.js`, which imports the implementation through a cache-busting
`?rev=` query, and a one-second poll of the `lib` directory disposes the previous
revision and starts the next one once a changed fingerprint repeats. The browser
half arrives in an open page through the harness's own live plugin composition;
a page refresh works too.

## Install

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

Copies the package into `<profile>\node_modules\dsh-model-icons` as a real
directory, regenerates `lib/live.js` from `lib/index.js` so the two cannot drift,
and appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. A
running harness picks the row up from the manifest change.

Uninstall: remove the name from `dsh.profile.bundles`, delete
`<profile>\node_modules\dsh-model-icons`, and delete
`<profile>\.dsh-model-icons` if you also want the cache gone.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | stable loader entry; owns the reload loop |
| `lib/live.js` | byte-identical copy of the entry, named by the loader row |
| `lib/host.js` | routes, catalog mirror, logo cache, settings |
| `lib/net.js` | one outbound GET on the process's route, then the environment's proxy |
| `client/client.js` | hand-authored browser bundle: the decorator and the settings page |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the loader row the profile's bundle list pulls in |
| `install.ps1` | install into a profile |

## Tests

Both halves are covered without touching the running app:

```powershell
node _probe\model-icons-host-test.mjs      # host: fake webServer, real origin fetch
node _probe\dom-test\model-icons-client-test.mjs   # browser: linkedom + stubbed mirror
```

The host test drives the registered route with fake request/response pairs and
asserts the catalog answer, a real logo fetch, `404` for a mark the origin does
not have, `400` for a traversal attempt, `403` for a non-loopback peer, `405` for
a wrong method, and the on-disk cache. The client test builds the exact markup
the harness menu, the `/model` popup and the skin render, and asserts which rows
get a mark, which icon each gets, that effort rows and headings stay bare, that
the monogram fallback appears for a missing logo, that a row added later is
picked up by the observer, that a pass is idempotent, and that an unload removes
every trace.

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a
