plugins.readme_text:
# Ctrl + Wheel Zoom

Hold **Ctrl** (or **⌘** on macOS) and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI.
A page-zoom plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI, distributed as an ordinary
DSH **profile bundle**: no build step, no runtime dependency, plain ESM.

## What it does

| Gesture | Result |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + wheel | Zooms the page around the pointer, 50%–200%, in 10% steps |
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + `+` / `-` | Same from the keyboard |
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + `0` | Back to 100% |
| Zoom chip (bottom-right) | Appears whenever the level is not 100%: click the percentage to reset, click **Fit to width** to fit the window |
| Settings → General | A **Page zoom** row with the host's stepper pattern and a reset button |

The chosen level is remembered in the browser (`localStorage`), and every listener, stylesheet and
the applied `zoom` property are removed when the plugin is disabled or unloaded.

A gesture that another component already handled (`preventDefault()`, e.g. an embedded code editor
or map with its own `Ctrl`+wheel zoom) is never stolen.

## Install

Ask the Harness agent to install it, or call the plugin manager yourself with the package located
by absolute path, a tarball, or a published name:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <absolute path to this package / a .tgz / a published name>
```

`install_bundle` links the package into the active profile (`$DSH_PROFILE_DIR`), adds it to the
profile's bundle list, and the Harness applies it live. A page refresh picks up the browser half in
a page that was already open.

To install it by hand instead, add the package to the profile's dependencies and to
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json`, then restart the Harness.

## Uninstall

```
plugin_manager  action: remove_bundle
                target: dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
```

## Requirements

- A Harness Web GUI (the client half declares `platform: "web"`; it is inert without a browser).
- Nothing else: the package has no dependencies, no build output, and no install scripts. Built-in
  client modules (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`) come from the shell's own module table.

## Sharing and publishing

The package is self-contained, so there are three ways to hand it to someone else.

### 1. A tarball

```bash
pnpm pack                        # writes dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom-1.0.0.tgz
```

Send that `.tgz`; the receiver installs it by path:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <path to dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom-1.0.0.tgz>
```

(`pnpm pack` writes the tarball beside `package.json`. DSH's own runtime ships a pnpm, so nothing
has to be installed first.)

### 2. The directory (zip / repository)

Zip this folder (or push it to a Git repository) and have the receiver install the **unpacked
directory** by path — `install_bundle` accepts a directory, and a folder is enough because there is
no build step.

### 3. npm (install by name for everyone)

This manifest is already publishable: `name` is the unscoped `dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom`, the row in
`cordis.patch.yml` names the same specifier, and there is no `"private": true`.

npm no longer issues long-lived "classic" tokens — they were permanently revoked on 2025-12-09 —
and publishing requires two-factor authentication. Pick one of the two ways through:

```bash
# A. A granular access token created with "Bypass two-factor authentication" enabled,
#    stored once as a credential:
#      //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=npm_...        in ~/.npmrc
pnpm publish --no-git-checks

# B. Any write token, with a one-time password supplied per publish:
pnpm publish --no-git-checks --otp=<6-digit code>
```

A token without bypass-2FA is refused with `403 ... Two-factor authentication or granular access
token with bypass 2fa enabled is required to publish packages`. Verify what a token can actually do
before blaming the command:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/tokens
#   "bypass_2fa": false   → use --otp, or recreate the token with the switch on
#   "permissions": [{"name":"package","action":"write"}]   → publishing is permitted at all
```

Note npm's stated direction: bypass-2FA tokens are on a path to removal (targeted for January 2027)
in favour of staged publishing or trusted publishing, so a long-lived automated release will need
one of those later.

Keep `name` in `package.json` and the `name:` line of `cordis.patch.yml` identical in every
release — the loader resolves the row through that specifier. Bump `version` for each release.

Afterwards anyone installs it by name:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
```

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: an empty `apply()`; the row exists so the bundle can be installed and toggled |
| `client.js` | Browser half: wheel/keyboard gestures, zoom state, chip and settings-row registrations, stylesheets |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The loader patch that inserts the `ctrl-wheel-zoom` row |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin-card title/description text; the row's own copy lives in `client.js` |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin-manager card artwork |

## How the zoom works

Zoom is CSS `zoom` on the document element. It scales layout, text and fixed overlay layers
together exactly like the browser's own page zoom, while the app's own scroll containers keep
working — a `transform: scale()` wrapper cannot scroll its oversized content, and a font-size
change would only touch text.

The wheel listener is registered in the capture phase on `window`, so it sees the gesture before
the app's scroll containers and blocks them from scrolling while `Ctrl` is held. When the viewport
itself scrolls, the plugin re-anchors it so the content under the pointer stays under the pointer.

Both UI surfaces read one store instance shared with the gesture writer, so the chip, the settings
stepper and the wheel listener can never disagree about the current level.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-select-skin

给 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的模型选择器换皮肤：胶囊芯片触发器 + 重做的下拉菜单。

## 截图

浅色主题：

![浅色主题下的模型选择器](docs/preview-light.png)

深色主题：

![深色主题下的模型选择器](docs/preview-dark.png)

## 效果

- **触发器**：胶囊芯片，含提供商彩点、`提供商 · 模型名`、思考档位标签
- **下拉菜单**：与官方弹层一致的半透明毛玻璃表面；分组标题显示提供商名 + 数量徽章
- **打开时自动定位**到当前选中的模型

## 安装

```bash
# 在 profile 的 node_modules 下软链本目录
ln -s /path/to/dsh-model-select-skin ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@local/dsh-model-select-skin
```

随后在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中插入插件行（本仓库已自带该补丁），重启 `dsh web` 即可。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `client.js` | 浏览器端：注册低优先级席位，遮蔽官方选择器 |
| `index.js` | Host 端：仅承载 bundle 身份，`apply` 为空 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，插入插件行 |
| `locale/` | 中英文案 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `docs/` | 界面截图及其生成脚本 |

## 原理

`conversation.input.model` 是单槽席位，默认由官方 `client-ui-model-selection` 占据。
本插件以 **-1 优先级**注册同一个槽位，遮蔽官方入口（最低优先级先渲染）。

数据与提交**不重新实现**：组件通过 `modelDirectories` 服务读取按会话共享的目录
（与官方选择器、`/model` 弹窗同一份存储），选择走 `directory.select()`，即
官方的 `session/selectModel` 链路。因此在任何位置做的切换都处处可见。

禁用或卸载本插件即可恢复官方 UI。

## 关于截图

上方两张图是**真实运行中的 DSH Web GUI 截图**（由 `docs/capture-screenshot.mjs`
驱动无头 Chrome 抓取），不是示意图。

脚本通过 CDP 注入一个本地自签的浏览器 cookie 来访问 `127.0.0.1:3080`，
随后展开模型下拉并裁剪到菜单区域。用法与前置条件见脚本头部注释。

plugins.description: DSH 插件：在插件设置卡里调会话自动压缩的触发阈值与保留比例，保存即时写进 agent preset 隔离的压缩引擎
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-threshold

在 **插件 → dsh-compaction-threshold** 的配置卡里调 DSH 的会话压缩阈值，保存后即时生效，不需要重启。

| 设置项 | 默认 | 范围 | 说明 |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| 触发阈值 | 80% | 17–90 | 自动压缩在**已路由模型上下文窗口**的百分之多少处触发 |
| 保留近期对话 | 16% | 1–89 | 压缩时逐字保留的最近对话比例，必须小于触发阈值 |
| 自动压缩 | 开 | — | 关闭后不再自动压缩，手动 `/compact` 仍可用 |

例：窗口 1,000,000 的模型，触发阈值 80% → 800,000 tokens 处压缩，逐字保留 160,000 tokens。

## 为什么不能只改 profile 配置

DSH 内核**本来就带压缩**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`，默认 `thresholdRatio = 0.8` /
`retainRatio = 0.16`），但在 web / desktop 装配下**改不到**：

- 组合里**进程级**那一行 `compaction-basic` 是被禁用的；
- 每个 **agent preset 在自己的隔离 realm 里各挂一个** `BasicCompactionEngine`
  （`presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml` 的 `compaction` 组，`isolate: { compaction: true }`）；
- 往 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 写同 id 行**不落到会话实际用的那个引擎**。

## 实现要点（内核 0.1.5-rc.2 实测）

1. **取得引擎**：`ctx.get('agentPresets').serviceFor(agent, 'compaction')`
   → 返回该会话所在 preset 隔离 realm 内的 `BasicCompactionEngine`。
2. **改值的正确姿势是「替换整个 config 对象」，不能原位赋值**：
   - `Object.isFrozen(engine.config) === true`，而 `config` 属性本身 `writable: true`；
   - 原位赋值在 ESM 严格模式下抛 `TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'thresholdRatio'`，
     被 `try/catch` 吞掉就等于**静默什么都没做**（这点极易踩坑）；
   - 引擎每次决策都重新读 `this.config`，所以整体替换即热更新。实测替换后 45 秒回读仍是新值。
3. **枚举存活会话用 `ctx.get('agents').list()`**：
   `sessionPersistence.list()` 的条目形状是 `{ header, revision, sizeBytes }`，
   会话 id 在 `entry.header.id` 里、**顶层没有 id**；照顶层取会永远扫到 0 个会话。
4. **两条落地路径**：
   - 保存设置时立即扫描存活会话写入（实测 1.5 秒内引擎即为新值）；
   - 每个 step 边界 `ctx.on('agent/pre-step', …, { prepend: true })` 再兜底同步一次。

不改压缩算法、不碰会话日志：摘要生成、消息替换、checkpoint、持久化、溢出恢复
全部仍是官方 `compaction-basic` 负责。设置值持久化在设置存储（命名空间
`dsh-compaction-threshold`），进程重启后由 step 边界重新应用。

## 安装（本机 DSH Desktop）

Desktop 独占 profile 装配，`dsh plugin add` 在本机不可用。走本地热装配：

```
npm pack                                  # → dsh-compaction-threshold-0.1.0.tgz
# 解包到 D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-compaction-threshold
# dev_install_package(dir, profile='desktop')
```

本插件宿主半边只 import `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（`0.2.0` 起 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`
的 `installSettingsSection` / `settingsNamespace` 已删除，导入它们会让宿主起不来）。
link 安装的插件目录没有自己的 `node_modules`，因此目录内建立一个**指回内核同一份**的
junction（不是拷贝，避免版本偏移）：

```
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/schemastery → <app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/schemastery
```

（`<app>` = 官方 Harness 安装目录，例如 `D:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app`。
注意**不要**指向社区 Desktop 或其它副本：目标一旦被卸载/移动，悬空链接会让插件
`failed to import`、宿主启动报错。）

装完**硬刷新页面**（Ctrl+Shift+R），在 **插件 → dsh-compaction-threshold** 的配置卡里
即可看到本行（0.2.0 起第三方插件的配置卡在插件页，不在「设置 → 通用」）。

> ⚠️ 改本插件的代码后需要**重启 DSH Desktop** 才生效：本机 super-injector 的
> `dev_reload_package` 拿不到 `loader.internal`，只会"重新装配"旧模块；
> 且 `dev_install_package` 见到已存在的 loader entry 会跳过 create。重启后由
> profile 的 bundles 列表正常装配。

## 验证

宿主日志（`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\dsh-<日期>.log`）里会有：

```
[dsh-compaction-threshold] audit-><写入路径> {"event":"applied","thresholdRatio":0.62,…}
```

同时会往下列第一个可写目录追加一行 JSONL 审计（`dsh-compaction-threshold.jsonl`）：
`$DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh` → 本插件目录。

## 限制

- 只调**阈值类**策略；压缩范围选择、摘要质量、按模型覆盖（`modelPolicies`）、
  摘要模型选择不在本插件范围内。
- 只支持**百分比**；按绝对 Token 设阈值需要知道每个模型窗口，未做。
- 若别处设过 `retainTokens`，本插件会清掉它（与 `retainRatio` 互斥）。
- 某个 preset 若没有压缩组（不压缩的 preset），`serviceFor` 拿不到引擎，本插件对它无效。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: create spec-compliant skills from the Web UI (Huawei Cloud / generic / REST API), with a 10-point evaluation loop
plugins.readme_text:
# Scenes Skill Creator

**在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里真跑官方 creator 技能——通用技能 / 标准API管理技能 / 华为云基础云服务技能——并实时展示过程、自动评测、不达标就打回修改。**

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator.svg)](https://github.com/wasteoneslife/dsh-skill-creator/blob/main/LICENSE)

包名 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator`，是一个 DSH bundle（Host 半边 + Client 半边，全部在 Harness 进程内，没有子进程、没有监听端口）。

## 它是什么

官方 creator 技能（`common-skill-creator` / `rest-api-skill-creator` / `huawei-cloud-skill-creator`）是给命令行或会话里的 agent 用的：需求要自己写清、流程要自己盯、产物好不好要自己判断。本插件把这件事搬进 Web 界面：

1. **需求传递**：侧边栏选分类、填表单，插件把内容整理成 creator 能直接开工的请求（已经给全的值不再反问）。
2. **过程展示**：按下「开始创建」后，Host 侧新起一个**真 agent** 执行该 creator 自己的流水线，面板实时渲染阶段清单与步骤日志。
3. **评测闭环**：创建结束后真跑一遍 10 分制评测，不达标就把扣分明细交回**同一个** creator 就地修改，直到达标或用完轮数。

**插件自己不做内容创作**：SKILL.md 怎么写、references 怎么摆、脚本怎么跑，全部由该 creator 当前版本决定（插件不内嵌副本、不二次实现；上游改了，插件行为就跟着改）。

## ✨ 主要特性

- **分三类组织需求**：侧边栏为 通用技能 / 标准API管理技能 / 华为云基础云服务技能，创建记录按分类隔离，默认打开通用技能。
- **真跑，不止给提示词**：创建由 creator 技能在真 agent 里执行；步骤日志逐条记录它的工具调用、阶段切换与模型报错。
- **实时展示阶段与步骤**：阶段清单按 creator 自己的标记点亮（华为云 Phase 1–6 / 通用技能 阶段 1–5 / 标准API Step 1–4），运行中每 1 秒刷新。
- **自动评测并打回修改**：10 分制、通过线 8.5；不达标把扣分明细发回同一个 creator 修改，最多 3 轮，到顶输出评测报告。
- **无人值守也不提问**：提示词里禁止提问；creator 若仍然提问，插件按"只读、不执行变更类操作"的策略自动答复并继续（最多 5 次）。
- **保护长任务不被误杀**：看门狗按**静默**判死（默认静默 8 分钟、整段 120 分钟兜底），并识别进程被挂起（休眠）后重新计时。
- **回看历史并可靠落盘**：运行记录原子写入磁盘（临时文件 + 重命名 + 备份 + 与磁盘记录合并去重），bundle 重载或 DSH 重启后仍能重新打开，最多保留 20 条。
- **自动发现产物目录**：通用/标准API 模式没有名称与目录字段，评测阶段从 creator 写文件的路径、以及 `<cwd>/skills` 下新出现的 `SKILL.md` 自动定位产物。
- **按需拉取华为云三级目录**：只有切到华为云分类才访问仓库，逐级读取并缓存（默认每路径 10 分钟）；默认分类打开页面不发请求。

## 快速开始

两种安装方式。装完后**必须重启 DSH 一次**——bundle 列表与补丁层只在启动时解析（不重启的表现是侧边栏没有图标，或面板 API 404）。

**方式一 · DSH 内（任意 profile，推荐）**：在会话里让 agent 用 Harness 自带的插件管理安装这个 spec：

```text
@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator
```

**方式二 · 桌面端 profile（命令行）**：把**同一个包名**同时写进该 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`（两处都要有）：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator   # 或用 npm install
```

```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator   # 或用 npm install
```

> **⚠️ 装完必须重启 DSH 一次**（包与配置在启动时加载）。
>
> 另外，安装用的包名必须与 `src/client.js` 里 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 的 id 完全一致（本包都是 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator`），不一致时浏览器侧会直接报 `bundle … loaded without registering "…"`。

最小可用配置（写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，`id` 与包内补丁一致）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-skill-creator
  name: '@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator'
  config:
    run:
      cwd: '/absolute/path/to/your/workspace'
      permissionPreset: 'danger-full-access'
      passScore: 8.5
      maxEvalRounds: 3
      evalReadonlyOnly: true
      idleTimeoutMs: 480000
      phaseTimeoutMs: 7200000
      toolWaitMs: 1200000
```

`run.cwd` 是技能落盘根，产物写在 `<cwd>/skills/…`。不设时回落到 DSH host 进程的 cwd（通常是 profile 目录），技能会被写进 profile 里而不是你的工作区。上面的 `run` 键要写全，原因见「配置」一节的坑。

### 命令行安装（等价方式）

```sh
# Web / 普通 profile
dsh plugin add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator

# 桌面端：先完全退出客户端，再指定 desktop profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator
```

装完**重启一次 DSH**。桌面端的 `dsh` CLI 随安装包提供（`resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`）；若手边没有该命令，也可以在插件页里直接填包名 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator` 安装。

## ⚠️ 权限要求（必读）

> **发布包默认 `run.permissionPreset: 'danger-full-access'`**（写在包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不是文档假设）。
>
> 原因：creator 流程要跑 bash 脚本（`ensure_cli.sh` / `validate-skill.sh` / `test-cli-commands.sh`）与云 CLI，这些 fork 在只读或 `workspace-write` 沙箱下会被审批拦住。无人值守时没有人点「允许」，运行就静默，随后被看门狗判死——表现为**"跑一半超时退出"**（实跑数据里确有 `permission: null` 的运行以 `等待「creator」超时：已静默 8 分钟（无任何工具调用或文本）` 结束）。
>
> **风险**：创建与评测 agent 都会以完全访问权限运行（可读写文件、执行命令）。请只在**信任的工作区**使用本插件。若改成受限 preset，请确保有人在场处理审批，否则长任务大概率静默超时。

## 三种技能类型

| 显示名（侧边栏顺序） | 内部 `mode` | 委托的官方 creator | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 通用技能 | `generic` | `common-skill-creator` | [grape-skills](https://gitcode.com/grape-dev/grape-skills) `main` → `skills/coding/scaffolding/common-skill-creator` |
| 标准API管理技能 | `api` | `rest-api-skill-creator` | [grape-skills](https://gitcode.com/grape-dev/grape-skills) `main` → `skills/coding/scaffolding/rest-api-skill-creator` |
| 华为云基础云服务技能 | `huawei` | `huawei-cloud-skill-creator` | [huaweicloud-skills](https://gitcode.com/huaweicloud/huaweicloud-skills) `master` → `skills/devtools/common/huawei-cloud-skill-creator` |

- 显示名就是侧边栏菜单文案，**数组顺序即菜单顺序（华为云固定最后）**，默认选中第一项（通用技能）。
- 每个菜单项下方还有一行**说明小字**，标明该分类对应的 creator 家族：通用技能 `common-skill-dev` · 标准API管理技能 `common-restapi-skill-dev` · 华为云基础云服务技能 `huawei-skill`。
- 内部 `mode` 键是 Host API 契约（`POST /run` 的 `spec.mode`）与记录隔离键；改显示名不动它。
- **记录按分类隔离**：创建记录卡片只列出当前分类的历史。
- **三级目录按需拉取**：只有切到华为云分类才访问仓库（逐级读取，默认每路径缓存 10 分钟）。
- 三个 creator 都会按需注册为可加载的 DSH skill，缓存 24 小时，可点「从仓库拉取最新」强制刷新。

各分类要填什么：

| 分类 | 表单字段 |
| --- | --- |
| 通用技能 | 一个「技能功能描述」文本框（≥8 字符）。没有名称、目录、tags 字段——这些是打包约定，由该 creator 自己推导。 |
| 标准API管理技能 | 一个「REST API 技能需求」文本框（≥8 字符），占位符是一份需求模板：技能名称 / 一句话描述 / 目标系统 / API 地址 / 认证方式 / **API 文档**。 |
| 华为云基础云服务技能 | 一级目录（固定 `skills`，不可改）+ 二级目录 + 三级目录（均从仓库实时读取）+ 技能名（前缀 `huawei-cloud-` 固定，后缀 1–64 字符小写字母/数字/连字符）+「功能概括」文本框（可留空）。技能名即仓库路径第四级：`skills/<二级>/<三级>/<技能名>`。 |

**标准API模式里「API 文档」最关键**：该 creator 不猜端点——它解析你给的文档，或用 curl 实测探测；两者都拿不到就不产出。请把凭据放进环境变量，不要写在这段文本里。

## 工作流程

```text
填需求（选分类 + 填表单）
  └─ POST /dsh-skill-creator/api/run
       └─ Host：ctx.agents.create() 起一个真 agent
            agent.followup(creator 请求)           把需求交给 creator 技能
            ctx.on('agent/assistant-stream', …)    把流式帧转成阶段与步骤
       └─ 面板每 1 秒 GET /run?id=…                 渲染阶段清单 + 步骤日志

创建结束（creator 空闲）
  └─ 目标目录自动发现（通用/标准API 模式表单里没有名称，路径由 creator 决定）
       └─ 评测第 1 轮（真跑只读用例，10 分制）
            ├─ 得分 ≥ 8.5 ──────────────────────► done（附评测报告）
            └─ 得分 < 8.5 → 扣分明细 followup 回同一个 creator 就地修改（fixing）
                 └─ 评测第 2 轮 … 最多 3 轮
                      ├─ 本轮提升 < 0.2 ────────► below-threshold（早停，附报告）
                      └─ 3 轮到顶仍未达标 ──────► below-threshold（附报告）
```

运行状态：`creating` → `evaluating` →（`fixing` → `evaluating`）* → `done` / `below-threshold`；任何阶段都可能 `cancelled` / `failed`，进程重启后残留的进行中记录会标为 `interrupted`。运行中可「取消」，结束后可「← 返回」再开一次。

各 creator 的阶段清单（阶段标题就是面板上显示的文案，插件按 creator 自己的标记点亮，**只前进不回退**）：

| --- | --- |
| 华为云 | Phase 1 · 需求分析（苏格拉底式问答） |
| 华为云 | Phase 2 · 技术调研（CLI→SDK→API 三级回退） |
| 华为云 | Phase 3 · 文档生成（SKILL.md + references + 载体） |
| 华为云 | Phase 4 · 测试准备（templates/test-vars.json） |
| 华为云 | Phase 5 · 详细测试（真实执行验证） |
| 华为云 | Phase 6 · 资源清理与合规检查 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 1 · 需求分析 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 2 · 设计 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 3 · 生成（skill 包 + 模板） |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 4 · 验证（规范 + lint 检查点双通过） |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 5 · eval 迭代 |
| 标准API | Step 1 · 需求澄清 |
| 标准API | Step 2 · 技术调研 |
| 标准API | Step 3 · 骨架生成 |
| 标准API | Step 4 · 自测与收尾（创建 PR/交棒属平台流水线，本面板不做） |

## 评测机制（10 分制，通过线 8.5）

创建结束后**真跑一遍评测**：由评测 agent 在被测 skill 目录里执行只读用例，再由本地评分器按平台口径打分。

| 维度 | 满分 | 明细 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 稳定性 | 4 | 功能可用 3 + 触发词充足度 1 |
| 成本 | 1 | 消耗总 token |
| 效率 | 2 | 8 项 × 0.25：完成时间 / 工具失败次数 / 重试次数 / cli / sdk / api 调用次数 / LLM 调用次数 / 上下文是否压缩 |
| 安全 | 3 | 本地规则扫描：高危 ≥1 扣 3；告警 ≥2 扣 2；告警 1 扣 1 |

- **通过线 8.5/10**（即"85 分"）；分级参考平台：`=10` 技能满分、`[8,10)` 优质技能。
- **容差 10% 且单向**：成本与效率只罚超支、不罚更省；基线为 0 视为无参照。**但从第 2 轮起才与基线比较**——首轮不再"白送"（见下条）。
- **绝对上限始终生效**（`evalTokenBudget` / `evalDurationCapSeconds` / `evalMaxToolCalls` / `evalMaxLlmCalls` / cli·sdk·api 上限 / 工具失败与重试必须为 0）：无基线时按绝对上限判定，有基线时"≤ 基线×(1+10%)"与"≤ 绝对上限"**同时**满足才满分；更省永远不罚。默认值取自实测量级（评测轮 token 23965/28550/38999/39617、时长 42.5/58.2/65.75/394.1 s、工具调用 4-8、cli 2-6、llm 4-6、工具失败 0、重试 0），正常轮次不会误伤。
- **功能可用 = 外部证据，不是评测 agent 的自编用例**：必须真实执行**被测 skill 自带夹具**里的 ≥ `minFixtureCases`（默认 3）条只读/语法用例，每条带「执行命令 + 观测结果（退出码/输出片段）+ 与期望的对比结论」，且没有 `fail`。只有自编用例、缺证据、夹具不存在或用例数不足 → 这 3 分直接 0，理由写进 `checks.functionalEvidence`；自编用例只能作为补充。
- **本地门禁（确定性，不需要 agent）**：任一不过 → 总分压到 `gateScoreCap`（默认 7.0）并确保 `verdict !== 'pass'`，同时进扣分明细、修复提示词与报告。

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: 密钥泄露扫描：密钥被提交进仓库了吗
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-secret-scan

[![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**密钥与敏感信息扫描** —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 skill 插件。

提交前、发布前、开源前，把不该出现在代码里的东西找出来。

这是这一组技能里唯一**通用**的（不限中国大陆）—— 因为"密钥进了仓库"是所有技术团队都会踩的坑。

## 它能扫出什么（7 条规则）

技能负责「怎么处理」，规则引擎负责「有没有」。一条命令出证据：

```bash
dsh-secret-scan --root <项目路径>   # 扫一遍
dsh-secret-scan --demo             # 看内置演示样本
dsh-secret-scan --list-rules       # 列出规则与依据
```

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `SECRET-PRIVATE-KEY` | PEM 私钥块（标签 + 后面真跟着密钥正文）| 严重 |
| `SECRET-AWS-AKID` | `AKIA` + 16 位 | 高 |
| `SECRET-GITHUB-TOKEN` | `gh[pousr]_` / `github_pat_` | 高 |
| `SECRET-SLACK-TOKEN` | `xox[baprs]-` / `xapp-` | 高 |
| `SECRET-STRIPE-LIVE` | `sk_live_` / `rk_live_` | 高 |
| `SECRET-CREDENTIAL-LITERAL` | 变量名含 secret/token/password + 高熵字面量 | 中 |
| `SECRET-STRIPE-PUBLISHABLE` | `pk_live_` —— **Stripe 官方说可公开，故单列低级别** | 低 |

**输出不落原值**：正则只消费前缀或变量名，密钥正文放在零宽断言里，
所以报告里的证据是 `AKIA` / `ghp_` / `secretAccessKey` 这种，**不含密钥本身**。

**只写标签不写正文不报**（文档里贴格式示意不误报）；`process.env.SECRET` 这类不报。

**已知边界**：`.pem` / `.key` / `.p12` 文件本体不被引擎当文本读（core 的扩展名名单没收录），
直接放 `server.pem` 会漏；同样私钥写成 `id_rsa` 或贴进代码/文档则能命中。报告会如实列出「跳过文件」。

## 它查什么

| 类别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 **高置信令牌** | 云厂商 Access Key（AKIA/LTAI/AKID）、GitHub/npm/Slack 令牌、Google API Key |
| 🔴 **私钥与证书** | `id_rsa`、`*.pem`/`*.p12`/`*.jks`，以及嵌在代码里的 PEM 私钥内容 |
| 🔴 **凭据文件进了 git** | `.env`、`credentials.json`、`.npmrc` 等是否已被 `git ls-files` 跟踪 |
| 🟠 **配置里的敏感赋值** | `password=` / `token=` / `api_key=` 这类硬编码（误报较多，逐条看） |
| 🟠 **内部信息** | 内网 IP（`10.` / `192.168.` / `172.16-31.`）、内部域名（`.corp` / `.internal`） |

**退出码 1 = 有高置信命中**，可直接挂到 pre-commit 或 CI 上。

## 两条刻意的设计

**1. 输出默认打码**（只留前后 4 位）。

扫描工具把完整密钥打进终端或日志，等于换个地方又泄露一次。要看全必须显式 `--reveal`，
而且别把输出存进文件或贴进聊天。

**2. 技能正文里，处置顺序比扫描本身更重要**：

```
1. 轮换密钥  →  2. 清理代码  →  3. 再决定要不要改写历史
```

**删代码不会让已泄露的密钥失效** —— 它还在 git 历史、已推送的远端副本、CI 日志与缓存、
你的 shell 历史和编辑器备份里。判断标准很简单：**这个密钥有没有离开过你的机器？**

一个只教人"删掉就好"的工具，是在帮倒忙。

## 误报怎么办

文档里的示例值（`your-api-key-here`、`sk-example-...`）**已自动过滤**。测试用的假密钥建议
写成含 `example` / `dummy` 的明显假值，同样会被过滤。

剩下的 🟠 逐条看上下文 —— 但**别因为误报多就不看报告了**，那正是这类工具失效的方式。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-secret-scan
```

## 用法

```bash
# 脚本路径由插件注册时注入到技能正文里，或到安装目录找 skill/scan.sh
scan.sh --dir /path/to/repo          # 默认打码
scan.sh --dir /path/to/repo --reveal # ⚠️ 打印完整密钥，仅排障时用
```

## 与相邻技能的边界

| 包 | 管什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **`dsh-secret-scan`** | **内部信息进了代码仓库**（该不该提交、提交了怎么补救） |
| `dsh-cn-compliance` 的 I 类 | **内部文件的公网暴露面**（被搜索引擎或公开链接读到） |

两者的交集是"内部信息"，但一个看**版本控制**，一个看**暴露面**。

## 许可

MIT

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [**密钥扫描**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。

> Multi-agent equity & fund research pipeline **skill plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://harness.deepseek.com).
> 同一包内提供**两个 skill**，共用脱敏门禁与环境约定：
>
> | skill | 用途 | 角色 |
> |---|---|---|
> | `stock-research` | 单只 A 股行情/估值/周期/政策分析 | 6 角色（协调员/数据员/政策员/估值周期员/风控员/审计员），双盲隔离 + 三轮审计 |
> | `fund-research` | **基金穿透式研究**（主动/指数/ETF/联接/FOF/QDII/债基） | 7 角色（协调员 + 基金画像穿透/宏观政策/行业趋势/公司估值/绩效归因/反方审查），五阶段流程 |
>
> 最终都产出**每个数字带【来源|日期|口径|类型】、落盘前过 PII 脱敏**的研究报告。

**仅供研究参考,不构成投资建议。不接入任何交易通道,全程只读公开数据。**

## Install 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub(发布后)
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add github:<your-user>/dsh-invest-research

# 或从本地目录 / zip 解包后
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add path/to/dsh-invest-research
```

> **v0.3.0 起包名由 `dsh-stock-research` 改为 `dsh-invest-research`**（加入了基金研究能力）。
> GitHub 旧地址会自动重定向；已安装旧版的用户请移除后按新名重装。

重启 DSH → 新会话里说 **"分析 600048"**（stock-research）或 **"分析基金 025490"**、**"穿透这只基金的持仓"**（fund-research）即触发。

## Quick check 安装自检

```bash
# 1) 个股取数冒烟(需可访问 push2.eastmoney.com;失败多为网络环境而非代码问题)
python assets/skills/stock-research/tools/fetch_data.py --code 600000 --out /tmp/sr/data.json
# 2) 基金取数冒烟(需可访问 fund.eastmoney.com)
python assets/skills/fund-research/tools/fetch_fund.py --code 025490 --out /tmp/fr/fund.json --peer-stocks 10
# 3) 基金取数器离线自测(30 条断言,不依赖网络,期望 exit 0)
python assets/skills/fund-research/tools/test_fund_tools.py
# 4) 脱敏门禁行为自检(27 场景,期望 exit 0)
python assets/skills/stock-research/tools/test_gate.py
```

## What's inside

| 组成 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `assets/skills/stock-research/SKILL.md` | 个股流程总纲 + 环境解析(`EQUITY_PY` / `EQUITY_SECRET_SCANNER` / `$RUN` / `$ARCHIVE`) |
| `assets/skills/stock-research/roles/*.md` ×6 | 各角色完整提示词(含 2026-10-15 真实事故教训固化:单一数据源、口径并列、先落盘再细化) |
| `assets/skills/stock-research/tools/fetch_data.py` | 东财双通道行情/历史取数 + 分位/最大回撤衍生计算;**空数据退出码 1** |
| `assets/skills/stock-research/tools/fetch_fundamentals.py` | **(v0.2.0)** 可选 akshare 财务基本面通道:ROE/每股净资产/负债率/现金流 + PE·PB 近一年真分位;未装 akshare 时退出码 1 不阻断主流程 |
| `install_akshare.ps1` / `requirements.txt` | **(v0.2.0)** 沙箱内离线装 akshare(Node fetch 下 wheel + `--no-index --find-links`),绕开 pip 平台临时目录 `WinError 5` 与 schannel 两个坑 |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/SKILL.md` | **(v0.3.0)** 基金流程总纲:五阶段、10 章报告、5 个结论标签、三种情景、跟踪清单、条件式行动 |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/roles/*.md` ×7 | **(v0.3.0)** 协调员 + Agent1–Agent6 完整提示词,统一 7 项提交格式 |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/fetch_fund.py` | **(v0.3.0)** 基金身份/净值/多期持仓/行业配置/债券持仓/规模份额/持有人/资产配置/经理/基准对比/重仓股快照;多通道降级,**空数据退出码 1** |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/test_fund_tools.py` | **(v0.3.0)** 30 条离线断言(内联 fixture + 网络桩,零网络) |
| `tools/sanitize_check.py` | 落盘前 PII 门禁:5 类泄漏规则 + 5 层公开信息白名单(财报科目/政策条款/金融术语/**基金公开披露**/否定声明);混合陷阱必拦 |
| `tools/test_gate.py` | 门禁行为自检 27 场景(真泄漏必拦/公开条款必放/基金披露必放/陷阱必拦) |
| `tools/run_pipeline.ps1` | Windows PowerShell 引导脚本(ASCII-only,PS 5.1 兼容) |

## Requirements
- DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc(skill 注册走 Host `skills` 服务;**无该服务时插件加载为 no-op,不会报错**)
- Python 3.10+(DSH 自带 runtime 直接可用;取数零第三方依赖,akshare 可选)
- 网络可达 `push2.eastmoney.com` / `push2his.eastmoney.com`(行情);政策核对建议搭配 [`dsh-web-search-pro`](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-web-search-pro)(免费 anonymous 源,本插件按 `read.fetch`-为主设计)

## 环境变量(全部可选)

| `EQUITY_PY` | 指定 Python 解释器(默认自动解析 DSH 自带 runtime) |
| `EQUITY_SECRET_SCANNER` | 外接凭据扫描器路径(如 audit-secrets.py);未设则明示 skipped,内置 PII 规则照常生效 |

## Privacy
- 报告**禁止出现**个人持仓/成本/资金量——落盘前 `sanitize_check.py` 强制拦截(退出码非 0 禁止写入,无绕过开关);
- 政策原文中的条款数字(如"单户上限100万元")是公开信息,白名单放行且**不改写**;
- 所有产物默认留在用户工作区,是否归档进个人笔记库(Vault/Obsidian)由用户显式配置 `$ARCHIVE`。

# dsh-intelligent-ui Interactive cards in DeepSeek Harness chats. The model writes a small interface program, the chat draws it as a native card, and every control recomputes in your browser without another model call. A button sends its text as your next message. [中文](README-zh.md) | | | |---|---| | Requires | DeepSeek Harness **>= 0.2.1-alpha.1** (below 0.3.0), web UI | | Desktop apps | **Not supported yet.** The desktop app (0.2.0-rc.2) is below the required version, so the plugin does not install or activate there. Support will follow once the desktop app ships 0.2.1-alpha.1 or later. | | Install | Settings → Plugins → Add plugin → `https://github.com/StarsHarryZhu/dsh-intelligent-UI` (needs `git` on `PATH`), then restart the harness and reload the page | ## The 27 components One card per component, drawn by this plugin in the host's light theme. The program behind each card is in [`docs/SAMPLES.md`](docs/SAMPLES.md). | Component | Group | What it shows | Screenshot | |---|---|---|---| | `card` | Layout | The framed root: optional title, padding, and gap. | | | `col` | Layout | A vertical stack in reading order. | | | `row` | Layout | Equal-width cells side by side; they wrap on a narrow screen. | | | `grid` | Layout | An even grid of one to four columns. | | | `title` | Text | A headline line in five sizes. | | | `text` | Text | A sentence, with `{…}` live values. | | | `badge` | Text | A one-word status label in five tones. | | | `callout` | Text | One emphasized remark: an assumption, a caveat, a next step. | | | `divider` | Text | A hairline separator. | | | `link` | Text | A citation link, opened only when clicked. | | | `image` | Text | An inline `data:` image with alt text and a caption. | | | `metric` | Data | One prominent number that recomputes as controls move. | | | `progress` | Data | A proportion bar. | | | `table` | Data | A comparison table; `current=` highlights a row. | | | `keys` | Data | Label and value pairs for exact figures. | | | `list` | Data | A bulleted list; `current=` highlights an item. | | | `steps` | Data | A numbered procedure; with `mono=true` and `current=`, a code listing with the running line highlighted. | | | `chart` | Data | A bar or line chart. | | | `plot` | Math | Curves of y = f(x) with a marked point, its tangent, and a shaded integral. | | | `formula` | Math | A typeset expression with its live value. | | | `slider` | Controls | A range slider bound to a number. | | | `numberInput` | Controls | Exact number entry. | | | `textInput` | Controls | A one-line text field. | | | `select` | Controls | A dropdown choice. | | | `checkbox` | Controls | An on/off switch. | | | `button` | Action | Sends its text as your next message, then locks the card. | | | `player` | Animation | A control bar at the bottom of the card: plays, pauses, steps, and scrubs a number at 0.5× to 2×; everything that reads it follows. | | ## How it works - The plugin registers one tool, `ui_render`, and one skill, `dsh-intelligent-ui`, which teaches the model when a card beats prose. The model never writes HTML or JavaScript: its program is checked against the 27-component catalog and stored with the tool result. - A card draws in the tool row while the reply streams, and under the reply once it finishes. Moving a control recomputes every figure locally. - A `player` animates a card: code traced line by line, an algorithm's passes, a point moving along a curve. plugins.description: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, what it shadows, and whether the copies agree.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-which

**Command resolution forensics for DeepSeek Harness.** When you type `node`, a shell answers with a rule that is longer than people remember — PATH order, then PATHEXT on Windows or the executable bit elsewhere, with builtins short-circuiting the whole thing. `dsh-which` reports what that rule actually decided, what it shadowed, what shape PATH itself is in, and whether the copies behind one name agree on a version.

Every failure it names is silent. The command runs; it is just not the one you meant.

```
dsh-which · node
  winner:   C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
  kind:     native binary
  from:     PATH[0]  C:\Program Files\nodejs
  size:     84MB
  modified: 2025-11-03T09:14:00.000Z
  version:  v24.13.0  (--version)
  searched: 9 PATH entries

  shadowed — 1 other directory holds this name:
    PATH[6]  C:\Users\me\scoop\shims\node.EXE  native binary  84MB
      ↳ reports v20.11.1

  ⚠ the copies behind this name report different versions — the one that runs is the one at PATH[0].
```

That last block is the whole reason this exists. Two Node installations, one on PATH, and nothing anywhere tells you which one a command gets.

## Why not just run `which`

1. **`which` does not exist on Windows**, and where it does exist it answers a narrower question. It reports the file it found; it does not report the file it skipped.
2. **`which` inherits the rules under investigation.** Shelling out to a resolver to explain resolution means trusting the resolver you are debugging. The rules here are reimplemented as pure functions over an injected filesystem (`lib/resolve.js`), so they are testable against fixtures instead of against whatever is installed on the test machine.
3. **Shell builtins are not files.** `which cd` on most systems walks every PATH entry to report something that has nothing to do with what runs. This plugin says `builtin` and explains that PATH was never consulted.
4. **The interesting output is the shadowed copy.** "What runs" is one line. "What else answers to this name, and why is it not running" is the diagnosis — a stale global install behind a fresh local one, a `.cmd` shim in front of a real binary, a file that exists but was never made executable.
5. **Reporting is the whole job.** There is no PATH-editing tool here. A plugin that silently rewrites PATH is a plugin that breaks a machine.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-which
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```sh
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-which
```

Optional configuration, in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: which
  name: 'dsh-which'
  config:
    probeByDefault: false        # run a version probe on every resolve
    probeShadowedByDefault: false # probe the shadowed copies too
    probeTimeoutMs: 4000
    maxSweepFiles: 400
    runtimes: [node, npm, pnpm, python, git]
```

| key | default | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `4000` | How long a version probe may take before it is abandoned. |
| `probeByDefault` | `false` | Probe every resolve without being asked. Slower, explains more. |
| `probeShadowedByDefault` | `false` | Probe the shadowed copies too. Multiplies the process spawns. |
| `maxSweepFiles` | `400` | Files examined in one sweep, so a huge directory cannot stall a session. |
| `runtimes` | node, npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, python, python3, pip, pip3, uv, git, rg, fd, make, pwsh, bash | Commands the environment report resolves. |

Probing is off by default because it spawns processes, and a diagnostic that costs four seconds on every call is a diagnostic people turn off.

## Tools

### `which_resolve`

Resolve one command and report what runs, what it shadowed, and — on request — what each copy reports as its version.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string, **required** | A name (`node`) or a path (`./build.sh`, `C:\tools\x.exe`). |
| `probe` | boolean | Run the winner with a version flag. |
| `probeShadowed` | boolean | Probe the shadowed copies too, so versions can be compared. |

A name that resolves to nothing is an answer, not an error:

```
dsh-which · build
  not found
  the name exists on PATH but nothing with that name is runnable
  searched: 45 PATH entries

  the name exists, but nothing with it can run:
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        … and 37 more
```

The count is the finding; the enumeration is the evidence, and past eight directories the evidence stops being read. The lines that save an hour are the second and third: the name *is* on PATH, the file simply cannot run. On POSIX that means no executable bit — a shell walks right past it into later PATH entries, or fails.

An explicit path never consults PATH, and the report says so:

```
dsh-which · /repo/scripts/build.sh
  winner:   /repo/scripts/build.sh
  kind:     script
  from:     given as a path, PATH was not consulted
  size:     2.3KB
  searched: 0 PATH entries
```

### `which_path`

The shape of PATH itself: every entry in resolution order, with duplicates, entries whose directory is gone, and entries containing an unexpanded variable.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showNoise` | boolean | Include `/usr/bin`, `/bin` and friends, omitted by default as uninformative. |
| `limit` | number | Maximum entries listed. Defaults to 40. |

```
dsh-which · PATH
  9 entries · 8 unique directories
  1 duplicate entry · 1 dead entry

  entries, in resolution order:
    [ 0] C:\Program Files\nodejs
    [ 1] C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm
    [ 2] C:\Windows\system32
    [ 3] C:\Windows
    [ 4] C:\tools\git\cmd
    [ 5] C:\Program Files\nodejs  — dup of [0]
    [ 6] C:\Users\me\scoop\shims
    [ 7] D:\old-python\Scripts  — missing
    [ 8] C:\Users\me\bin

  Duplicates are usually an installer that prepends itself on every run. Harmless until you edit "the" entry and two copies of it remain.

  Dead entries are skipped silently by every shell, so an uninstalled toolchain leaves a hole that only shows up when its command fails.
```

A dead entry is invisible by construction: shells skip it without a word, so the hole only surfaces later as "command not found" for something that was there yesterday. An unexpanded `%USERPROFILE%` is worse — it can never resolve, no matter what the variable is set to.

### `which_env`

One page describing the command environment: platform, shell, working directory, PATH findings, PATHEXT, and where each common runtime resolves from.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | Maximum runtimes listed. Defaults to 30. |

```
dsh-which · environment
  platform: win32  arch x64  node v24.13.0
  shell:    pwsh.exe  (C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe)
  cwd:      C:\repo
  PATH:     9 entries · 8 unique
            1 duplicate · 1 dead
  PATHEXT:  .COM .EXE .BAT .CMD

  resolved runtimes:
    · node  C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
    · npm  C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.CMD
    · pnpm  C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm.CMD
    · git  C:\tools\git\cmd\git.EXE
    ✗ python  not found

  1 runtime(s) exist in more than one place on PATH: node
```

The shell line matters more than it looks. `pwsh` and `cmd` disagree about builtins and about `.ps1`, so a report that names the wrong shell is a report nobody should trust.

### `which_sweep`

Sweep a directory of scripts and report, for each name that looks like a command, whether the copy in *that* directory is the one that would run.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `directory` | string, **required** | Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `limit` | number | Maximum rows listed. Defaults to 60. |

```
dsh-which · sweep C:\repo\scripts
  3 command(s)
  1 resolve outside this directory (shown with ↪)
  1 do not resolve at all

  ↪ build.cmd  → C:\tools\build\build.cmd
  · deploy.cmd  C:\repo\scripts\deploy.cmd
  ✗ smoke.cmd  does not resolve

  A ↪ means a copy in this di
